This research presents a novel utility function for assessing withdrawal efficiency, based on the framework of the consistency principle. This principle proposes that maximum utility is achieved when the withdrawal amount is constant at target percentage α through the planning horizon. The problem is formulated as an optimal control problem and is solved using dynamic programming. A simulation study confirms the model’s accuracy by simulating 10,000 random walks. While the model uses sample data from SPY and TLT ETFs, the model is versatile to incorporate exogenously provided portfolios. It also factors in longevity risk with minor modification. The paper proposes future avenues of exploration to expand the number of variables and use reinforcement learning as a method to resolve significantly more complex problems.

articleTitle: Design of Improved Reference Window for 2D CFAR and Implementation on Zynq
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: Constant false alarm rate (CFAR) detector is the key device in radar system, which usually needs two-dimensional processing for sea surface scene. In order to improve the detection ability and accuracy of the detector, an improved two-dimensional CFAR detection window is proposed by optimizing the selection rules of reference cells. The performance of the window is tested with simulated data and measured data. Among them, the processing of measured data is realized based on Zynq platform, and the overall scheme of radar data reading, writing and processing is innovatively designed, whose working stability and processing accuracy meet the requirements. CFAR detection results indicate that the improved reference window can effectively improve the ability of sea surface target detection and false alarm suppression, which shows certain engineering application value.

articleTitle: Research on the maintenance simplicity of civil aircraft based on the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: Through the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method, the simplicity of maintenance is analyzed. The maintenance simplicity of the scheme can be effectively analyzed from five aspects: the simplicity of fault isolation and installation test, simplicity of the access for maintenance, the simplicity of assembly and disassembly equipment, the simplicity of support sources and maintenance frequency. The method used in this paper can effectively reflect the maintenance simplicity of different schemes via fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method for decision-making.

articleTitle: PHM Verification and Validation of Aviation Equipment Based on System Engineering
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: With the increasing demand for health management technology for advanced aviation equipment, the rapid development of domestic prognostics health management (PHM) technology is promoted. At present, the verification and validation of PHM technology for aviation equipment has become a problem that hinders the implementation of PHM technology from theoretical research to engineering. In view of the lack of systematic scientific guidance for PHM technology verification in the application of aviation equipment engineering, a system engineering-based PHM verification and validation of aviation equipment was proposed, and the PHM verification and validation activities that need to be carried out at each stage of aviation equipment development were clarified, and the input, Output and activity flow.

articleTitle: A Fault Diagnosis Method for Rotating Machinery Based on Compressed Sensing and Deep Convolutional Neural Network with SE Block
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: Long-term condition monitoring of rotating machinery at high sampling rate generates large amounts of operational data, causing serious problems for data storage, transmission and diagnosis. And traditional deep learning-based fault diagnosis algorithms lack a mechanism to distinguish the importance of big data features. To solve the above problems, inspired by compressed sensing (CS) and attention mechanisms, this paper proposes a fault diagnosis method for rotating machinery based on compressed sensing and deep convolutional neural networks (DCNN) with squeeze-and-excitation (SE) block, called CS-SEDCNN. Compressed sensing is used to reduce the amount of data and improve diagnostic efficiency. The SEDCNN model is constructed for fault identification. The SE block can selectively focus on important features and suppress less useful features, enhancing the feature learning ability on compressed data. The proposed method achieves high diagnostic accuracy and faster diagnostic speed on the acoustic emission dataset of the wind power condition monitoring and diagnosis test rig.

articleTitle: Thermal Strength Failure Reliability Analysis of Siding Structure Based on Stratified Sampling
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: As a siding structure widely used in the aerospace field, the vibration analysis is carried out independently without considering the ambient temperature, which can’t be attached to the actual engineering. This paper firstly summarizes a reliability analysis method based on stratified sampling, and then takes the titanium alloy panel structure as the research object, analyzes its structural response under high temperature conditions, and considers the differences in structural dimensions, material properties, loads and other factors. Deterministic, calculating the reliability of the panel structure under thermal stress. Finally, the sensitivity analysis of the structural response is carried out.

articleTitle: Joint optimization of condition-based maintenance and spare parts orders for a two-unit system
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: Both preventive maintenance and spare parts replenishment affect the system availability and total operation cost. Therefore, joint optimization of maintenance and spare parts orders is a research topic of practical significance. Most existing studies assume that corrective maintenance can only be taken at fixed inspection points, and the base-stock policy was often adopted. This paper investigates the optimal condition-based maintenance and spare parts inventory policy for a two-unit system considering immediate corrective maintenance. The joint optimization problem is formulized as the Markov decision process that are solved by the policy iteration. Numerical study shows that the proposed policy can reduce the long-run expected cost by 9.2% compared with the parameterized policy derived by the genetic algorithm. The structure of the optimal policy is also analyzed and discussed.

articleTitle: Reliability Test and Life Analysis of Slats Roller for Civil Aircraft
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: Firstly, the number of slats roller reliability test samples and test period were solved based on Weibull and Binomial distribution probability model, and the roller failure probability model was established by test results and the established roller test scheme. The detailed visual inspection task items of the slats roller on airline were analyzed based on MSG-3 analysis logic, then the timing of detailed visual inspection roller was determined based on Bayesian network. Finally, based on Markov model, the reliability of the roller in the whole life of the aircraft was analyzed. The results show that the continuous airworthiness of aircraft can be ensured through detailed visual inspection during the whole life of the selected slats roller, and the rollers can meet the design requirements of the whole life of the aircraft.

articleTitle: A Novel Maximum-Entropy Bayesian Integration Approach for Reliability Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: Reliability analysis based on data from various source is common today. Bayes theory is proved effectively in integrating prior information and field information. However, the complicated calculation and limited applicability have a negative effect on solution. And the fusion is imbalanced in some case. This paper investigates a novel approach to integrate degradation data and lifetime data for reliability analysis. Firstly, inverse Gaussian process model is adopted to model the degradation and the crude estimation can be solved by degradation data. After that, a constrained maximum-entropy Bayesian integration model is proposed for exploring more information from reliability life test. For simplifying the calculation, a pivot variable, failure probability, is defined and updated in this model. This allows us to derive the model parameters by fitting the failure probability curve rather than the calculation on Bayes posterior distribution. Accordingly, the reliability assessment can be conducted based on the inverse Gaussian process model. A case study illustrates the validity and improvement of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Abnormal Identification of Oil monitoring Data Based on Classification-Driven SAE
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: In order to accurately understand the operating state of the equipment, monitor the abnormality of the oil state data in time, and effectively extract the abnormal data information in the oil monitoring data, this paper established a classification-driven SAE oil monitoring data abnormality recognition model. The nonlinear characteristics of the data predicted the state of the oil data. The label information is introduced into the collected oil monitoring data, and then the data is preprocessed. The deep features in the oil monitoring data are extracted by the stacked autoencoder (SAE). In the coding stage, the oil monitoring data training network with labels is used to realize the identification of abnormal data. The experimental results showed that: Compared with the Back Propagation Neural Network (BPNN) and the Support Vector Machine (SVM) classifier, the classification-driven stacked autoencoder had higher anomaly identification accuracy and could effectively detect abnormal data in oil monitoring data, so as to identified the abnormal monitoring of equipment status.

articleTitle: A Continuous Short RMS-Based Grid Time Difference Localization Method for Reactor Loose Parts
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of the large localization error of the reactor loose parts in engineering, a continuous short RMS- based grid time difference localization method for reactor loose parts was proposed. A character parameter was constructed and a signal arrival time judgement method was proposed to determine the time difference when the bending wave generated by the impact of loose parts reaches different sensors, and the localization of reactor loose parts would be realized based on the time difference and grid positioning method. A simulation test data of loose parts are used to verily the effectiveness of the proposed method. The results showed that the grid time difference localization method of reactor loose parts based on continuous short RMS is effective.

articleTitle: Degradation State Recognition of Rolling Bearings Based on VMD–SVM
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: In response to the problem that the degradation state of rolling bearings is difficult to identify effectively, this paper proposes a degradation identification scheme of rolling bearing based on the combination of Variational Mode Decomposition (VMD) and Support Vector Machine (SVM). The method is composed of two steps: a) decompose the original data by VMD; b) use the decomposed data as input of SVM for training and testing for classification. By numerical experiments among combinations of different features, the best combination of features based on the data of University of Cincinnati is determined. The performance of the scheme is verified by comparison of numerical experiments with other models. The numerical experiments show that the proposed method can identify the degraded state of rolling bearings more accurately and facilitate advanced maintenance planning, which plays an important role in improving the overall reliability of mechanical equipment operation.

articleTitle: Research on electromagnet fault diagnosis technology of magnetic suspension system
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: In this paper, a fault diagnosis method based on system identification theory is proposed to solve electromagnet fault in maglev suspension system. First of all, the mathematical model of single-point suspension nonlinear system is established while considering external disturbance and track irregularity. A double closed loop PID suspension controller is designed, and the Simulink simulation model of the system is established. Secondly, the structural parameters of the system are fitted and corrected to restore the real characteristics of the system based on the Maxwell finite element simulation results. The system characteristic deviation under ideal assumption is reduced in the theoretical derivation of mathematical model. Finally, the identification algorithm for the key physical parameters of electromagnet is designed to realize the online monitoring and quantitative indication of faults. The Simulink fault detection module is built for simulation verification.

articleTitle: Reliability Design Optimization Method for Civil Aircraft Based on Failure Data
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: Reliability is an important technical index of civil aircraft, which is an inherent quality attribute of civil aircraft and will also directly affect the operation and dispatch. In this paper, the identification and analysis methods of failure data were proposed. The reliability design optimization method and process based on failure data were given. The method to prioritize the reliability design optimization and develop the optimization plan were presented, which could solve the hidden problems or weak links in the design and manufacturing process fundamentally, and improve the whole life cycle reliability and market competitiveness of the aircraft.

articleTitle: A Clustering Fault Diagnosis Method for Gas Turbine Performance Parameters Based on t-SNE
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: This paper proposed a clustering method for gas turbine fault diagnosis. Our method is based on t-SNE and focuses on its clustering capability. The goal is to cluster the data of different health states of the same gas turbine to judge the time of failure. In order to strengthen the clustering ability of t-SNE for gas turbine data, we take the time factor into consideration based on the characteristics of the continuity of gas turbine health status. As t-SNE doesn’t actually provide class information but returns the results of dimension reduction, we use quick grid clustering to process the dimensionally reduced data and offer clustering results. We design a simulation dataset and demonstrate the effectiveness of our method through multiple experiments. Finally, we also apply this method to a real-world dataset and get a good result.

articleTitle: A Knowledge Transfer-based Methodology for Risk Assessment of Emergency Schemes
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: Due to insufficient knowledge of rare accidents, it is essential to transfer knowledge from source systems with sufficient cases into target systems with limited cases. In this study, a knowledge transfer-based methodology is proposed to evaluate emergency schemes from the perspective of emergency risk in presence of limited accident cases. By considering dynamic evolution and operational characteristics of accidents, a hybrid model integrating dynamic Bayesian networks (DBN) and program evaluation and review technique (PERT) is introduced. In the integrated model, we transferred graph structures and parameters to obtain emergency schemes based on the similarities between the source systems and target systems. On the one hand, to design the operation of emergency schemes, we utilized PERT to judge the logical relationships and the response-time requirement of the emergency procedures. On the other hand, to evaluate and prevent emergency risk, we employed DBN to conduct the dynamic risk assessment of emergency operations.

articleTitle: A Temperature Simulation Model of Battery Thermal Management System Based on Distributed Parameters
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: The temperature change of the battery system has great hysteresis and nonlinearity. To predict the temperature field of the battery in real time, this paper proposes a three-dimensional multi-node thermal model, which consists of two parts: a multinode heat transfer model based on battery geometry and a finite element simulation to obtain thermal resistance parameters. Comparing the simulation results of this model in battery cells and battery packs with finite element simulation shows that the simulation error is no greater than 1°C, and the calculation time is reduced from two hours to less than 0.1s.

articleTitle: Missing Data Recovery Method of 3-PRR Planar Parallel Mechanism Based on Tensor Completion
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: High-end mechanical equipment plays an important role in health operation and maintenance in actual production, while sparsity and data loss of equipment health monitoring data is very common. Accurate recovery of missing data is very important for equipment health maintenance. In the framework of low-rank tensor completion-truncated nuclear norm (LRTC-TNN), the problem of missing data recovery of periodic motion vibration response is proposed, and the cycles × sliding-window × time third-order tensor is defined. Based on the framework of the alternating direction method of multiplier (ADMM), an effective algorithm is proposed to solve the optimal solution of each variable. Numerical experiments are carried out on the data set of the 3-PRR planar parallel mechanism, and the results show that the proposed algorithm can recover the missing data well during operation.

articleTitle: Power Harmonic Wave Analysis Using SPWVD
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: Power grid stochastic disturbance is very harmful for Power Quality. The paper proposed a Winger-Ville time- frequency distribution (SPWVD) to analyze power grid harmonic wave based on time domain wave, FFT and time-frequency distribution diagram, the short-term power quality can be monitored in real time. In terms of showing voltage frequency mutation, voltage sags, Voltage surge and power outage, the effectiveness and precision of the harmonic interference and the distribution of harmonic energy are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Optimization Of Secure Propagation Path Of New Media Short Video Based On Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: In the dissemination of new media short videos, superficial reading is rampant, and some short videos with serious and clear words are not disseminated. A new media short video propagation path optimization method based on ant colony algorithm is designed. Based on the complex network theory, considering the influence of the parameters in the model, the simulation of the new media short video information propagation model is implemented in the real network. Firstly, the LinkRank algorithm is used to evaluate the importance of information connection, build a new media short video information network, classify the change attributes of information, obtain the execution time and change propagation probability of each information change task through the change history data, and evaluate the above four changes in variables. On this basis, a multi-source variation propagation path optimization model with propagation intensity as the edge weight is proposed. A new media short video propagation path optimization model based on ant algorithm is proposed, and the new media short video propagation path is optimized. The propagation path optimization performance of the design method is tested. The test results show that the short video network propagation coverage of the design method under different networks is high, which proves that it has a good propagation path optimization performance.

articleTitle: Personalized and Stable Recommendation Algorithm of E-commerce Commodity Information Based on Collaborative Filtering
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: In order to improve the personalized recommendation effect of e-commerce commodity information and accurately capture the user's interest under different quantities of related topics, this paper designs a personalized recommendation algorithm of e-commerce commodity information based on collaborative filtering. Firstly, the framework of collaborative filtering recommendation algorithm is established, and the scoring relationship between user e-commerce commodity information models is obtained. Reuse the user rating data table to evaluate resources at different levels. Select the nearest neighbor, calculate the similarity of e-commerce commodity information based on collaborative filtering algorithm, and generate the recommendation list based on the uneven resource scoring matrix. The experimental results prove that the personalized recommendation of commodity information has good effect, high accuracy and certain application value.

articleTitle: Research on Measurement Certification Technology for Trusted Computing of On-board Operating system
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: Based on the complexity of space environment and the limitation of space resources, a dynamic measurement authentication method for spaceborne operating system with the trusted chip support is proposed, and the configurable key measurement object identification scheme and verification strategy are given. In this method, Key measurement objects and measurement strategies can be set according to the level of spaceborne application. The critical application processes in operation can be measured and verified periodically, then a system security protection verification mechanism for spaceborne software is obtained. The experimental results show that the dynamic measurement method improves the reliability of the system, and the performance meets the requirements of spaceborne applications, which has great practical value.

articleTitle: Rolling Bearing Composite Fault Diagnosis Method Based On Harmonic Vector Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: For the problem that traditional methods are difficult to identify bearing composite faults, a determined convolution blind source separation method based on harmonic vector analysis (HVA) was studied. First, HVA uses the sparsity of cepstral coefficients to capture the co-occurrence of harmonic components. Then a Wiener-like masking is constructed to make the signals separated at each iteration more independent of each other. Finally, the back projection technique is used to align the frequency scales of separated signals. The experimental data of bearing faults verily the feasibility of this method. The simulation experiments show that, this method is better than the classical method in separating the composite fault signals of rolling bearings. Therefore, the proposed method can realize the composite fault diagnosis of rolling bearings.

articleTitle: Incipient Fault Diagnosis of Asynchronous Motor Based on Stator Current Signal Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: Motor is the pillar of industrial development, and the motor diagnosis method based on current signal analysis is gaining popularity due to its non-invasive nature. In order to solve the incipient fault diagnosis problem of induction motor based on current signal, a method based on Frequency-domain Teager Energy Operator(FTEO) and Square Envelope Spectrum(SES) is proposed. To begin, a notch filter is used to remove the supply frequency in the current signal. Second, the instantaneous amplitude and frequency are calculated and the energy operator is calculated in the frequency domain. Finally, the energy operator is processed by Square Envelope Spectrum and then compared with the fault characteristic frequency of each component of induction motor, so as to realize the accurate identification of incipient faults. In order to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method, different degrees of bearing damage and rotor broken bar are injected into the motor towing test rig to obtain the stator current dataset, and the incipient failure detection performance of the proposed method is verified by comparing with that of the unimproved method.

articleTitle: An Imaging Method for Sculptured Surface Defect Detection Based on Compound Lighting and Image Fusion
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: With the development of computer technology, machine vision plays an increasingly important function in industrial detection, and light source is a very important part of it. At present, most of the light sources are based on a single way of illumination, which results in limitations in the detection of multiple types of defects on 3D optical surfaces (such as lenses). Therefore, the images acquired by industrial cameras cannot fully present these defect information. In order to overcome the above problems, this article proposes an intelligent method of composite light source fusion image processing, which realizes high-quality imaging of multi-defect targets. Finally, an experimental verification system is built to verify the effectiveness of the method proposed in this article.

articleTitle: Environmental Adaptability of Visual Perception System from Vibration-blurred Image Perspective
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: Vision-based perception systems are widely used in unmanned platforms and have an important role in tasks such as object classification, object detection, and instance segmentation. The function and performance of visual perception system is not only related to the sensing hardware and recognition algorithm, but also influenced by the external environment. In this paper, the detection performance of the artificial intelligence model is used as a metric to study the impact of vibration-blurred images on the environmental adaptability of visual perception system. The structure and function of AI-baesd visual perception system are analyzed, and two vibration-blurred image generation methods, vibration test and vibration simulation, are introduced. The experiment quantitatively verified the effect of mechanical vibration stress on the performance of AI model during the operation of visual perception system.

articleTitle: Mission Reliability Modeling Method of Assembly Process Considering Workpiece Quality Deviation
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: In recent years, assembly system has been developing towards multi-state, complexity, large-scale and intelligent trend, and complex assembly tasks and assembly processes as well as dynamic and changeable assembly environment have reduced the mission reliability of assembly system, resulting in low quality and low reliability of assembly products. In addition, with the large-scale and complex structure of assembly product and the deterioration trend of service environment is becoming more and more obvious, people have higher and higher requirements for its reliability and quality. Therefore, this paper proposes a mission reliability modeling method of assembly process considering workpiece quality deviation. Firstly, the connotation of assembly process mission reliability is proposed on the basis of clarifying assembly system components and operation principle. Secondly, from the perspective of system theory, the conceptual model of PQR chain, which is embodied as the chain conceptual model of assembly machine performance state (P), assembly process quality (Q) and product reliability (R), is innovatively proposed to analyze the relationship among assembly machine performance state, assembly process quality and assembly product reliability. Thirdly, the assembly process operation quality data is highly integrated and applied to the PQR chain, and the assembly process mission reliability model considering the workpiece quality deviation is established. Finally, the feasibility of the proposed method is verified by a double nozzle flapper valve assembling example.

articleTitle: Wireless Charging ROV Based on Visual Location
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: Research on underwater wireless charging of Remote Operated Vehicle(ROV) is of great significance to improve the endurance and work efficiency of ROV. Aiming at the requirement of precise docking between ROV and underwater wireless charging station for charging, a wireless charging ROV system based on visual location developed. The visual ranging performance, mechanical positioning function and wireless charging performance of the system were tested. Within a range of 2m, the ranging error did not exceed 1%, the docking success rate was high, and the charging efficiency reached 85%. The experimental results show that the system works stably and can significantly improve the working efficiency of ROV.

articleTitle: A Subsystem Data Based Reliability Acceptance Test Plan Derivation Method
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: Reliability acceptance tests are used to qualify product’s reliability, which decides whether the product could be accepted. For highly reliable systems, conventional reliability acceptance tests in standards are not preferred, as the test plans either require long test durations or induce high risks for both producer and consumer, which results from the facts that the methods only use the system test data. Meanwhile, some related reliability data, such as data from subsystem test, are often neglected. To make use of the subsystem data, this paper proposes a reliability acceptance test plan derivation method, to derive system test plans with short test durations while keeping producer and consumer risks low, compared with the conventional RAT plans. A case study is provided to illustrate that when using subsystem test data in deriving system test plans, our proposed method has the potential to reduce the risks and shorten the test duration as well.

articleTitle: Reliability and Sensitivity Analysis of First Excursion on Anti-ice Air Intake Pipe
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: The deterministic analysis of pipeline is extended to the probabilistic model of dynamic response, and the method of the first-displacement first-excursion dynamic reliability and sensitivity based on the displacement-first-excess failure criterion is proposed. In this paper, the reliability and sensitivity of anti-icing air-intake pipeline system for an aircraft are analyzed. The results show that the reliability of nodes 1, 56, 125, 128, 218 is lower, which should be paid attention to engineering design. In addition, modulus E, pipe outer diameter D1, pipe wall thickness T1, gas pressure PRE, have the most significant influence on the overall reliability, these parameters can be used as the main way to improve the reliability of pipeline system.

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis of The Optimal Process Parameters of Surface Mount Capacitor
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: As an energy storage component, capacitor is widely used in the field of aerospace. Surface mounted capacitor has the characteristics of small volume and easy to automatic assembly. But it is extremely sensitive to mechanical stress and thermal stress, failing frequently in the harsh environment of aerospace. In this paper, we used the steady-state thermal module and static structure module of ANSYS to carry out the thermal simulation and vibration simulation analysis of tantalum capacitor, and the maximum and minimum stress under different solder joint process parameters were obtained. Based on the simulation results, the thermal fatigue life of solder joint was calculated by Darveaux fatigue model, and the vibration fatigue life of the solder joint was evaluated by S-N double logarithm vibration fatigue curve. The highest life of solder joint was selected as the optimal combination of solder joint process parameters. In this paper, the optimal solder joint process parameters of tantalum capacitors were analyzed, which can guide the improvement of capacitor assembly process.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis of Rolling Bearing based on Optimal Resonance Sparse Decomposition
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: The method of resonance sparse decomposition (RSSD) is extensively used in rolling bearing fault diagnosis. The selection of the decomposition parameters plays a decisive role in fault separation. It is difficult to accurately diagnose the weak fault of rolling bearing by traditional methods. In this paper, the fault diagnosis method of the rolling bearing is performed based on signal resonance sparse decomposition. The resonance sparse decomposition is carried out according to the different quality factors (QF) of the harmonic component and the periodic impact component in the rolling bearing fault vibration signal. The decomposition effect of the signal resonance sparse decomposition method is closely related to the quality factor. However, the quality factor selection based on human experience is often not effective, and the interpretability is not strong. To ensure the accuracy of the parameter selection, this paper proposes a multi-parameter optimization method based on the Grey-Wolf optimization algorithm (GWO) for adaptive resonance sparse decomposition. The simulation test and application example show that this method can effectively extract the fault characteristic components of the bearing, eliminate the signal interference and noise, and correctly identify the fault state of the rolling bearing.

articleTitle: Robust Motion Pose Capture Method of Aerobics Based on Visual Simulation Imaging
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: During the exercise of bodybuilders, the accuracy of capturing is reduced due to the complexity of human joint motion and the fast speed of movement. In order to effectively capture the movement posture of Aerobics Athletes in real time, a method of Aerobics posture acquisition based on visual simulation imaging is proposed. Through the visual simulation imaging method, collect data of Aerobics Athletes' postures, and extract the characteristic data by denoise and windowing processing, establish the aerobics body position structure recognition model, and achieve the acquisition of Aerobics body position. The experimental results show that the motion posture prediction accuracy of the proposed method is high. And it can minimize the interference caused by the magnetic field and capture the posture of the athletes in real time. It shows that this method has certain application value.

articleTitle: An Unsupervised Multi-grade Domain-Adversarial Regression Adaptation Network for Online Remaining Useful Life Prediction of Rolling Bearing Across Machines
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: Recently, deep transfer learning technology has been introduced to solve remaining useful life (RUL) of rolling bearing across working conditions. These methods enhance the RUL prediction performance by utilizing the historically-accumulated degradation data from offline working conditions. However, for the problem of online RUL prediction across different machines, due to the changeable operating machines, it is hard to effectively solve the data with a large distribution difference by adopting domain adaptation methods across working conditions. To solve this problem, this paper proposes an unsupervised multi-grade domain-adversarial regression adaptation network for online remaining useful life prediction of rolling bearing across machines. First, by employing offline whole-life degradation data of different machines, a deep domain-adversarial multi-regression network is constructed as advanced adversarial model. Second, by updating the advanced adversarial model from pseudo-target bearing selected for each machine, the supervised information of the pseudo-target bearing is dynamically generated, and then intermediate model is constructed. Finally, the RUL of online target bearing under an unknown machine can be evaluated through feeding into the intermediate model. Experiments results on the IEEE PHM Challenge 2012 and XJTU-SY bearing datasets demonstrate that the proposed method obtains accurate prediction performance across different machines and provides a practical solution for online RUL prediction under an unknown machine.

articleTitle: Adaptive and Self-supervised Condition Monitoring Method for Machinery
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: Data-driven condition monitoring is conducive to ensuring the efficiency and reliability of machinery. However, the accuracy of condition monitoring results can be impaired by volatile operating conditions and insufficient separability of measurements. To address the problems, an adaptive and self-supervised condition monitoring method is proposed. First, operational variable regression models are established to suppress the unexpected influence of operating conditions on the measurements collected from machinery. Then, valid data representations related to health status are extracted by self-supervised learning to guarantee that the data under distinct health conditions are separable during monitoring, and reference models are obtained to characterize the normal operations. Finally, the similarity between real-time measurements and reference models is analyzed, and control chart statistics are established to evaluate the health conditions in online monitoring. Take breakage detection in wind turbine blades as an example, the effectiveness and superiority with respect to benchmark methods are demonstrated using the data acquired from actual wind farms.

articleTitle: Order Track Variational Stacked Autoencoder Fault Diagnosis Model for Complex Working Conditions
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: The fault diagnosis effect of stacked autoencoder in complex working conditions is not meeting expectations due to the combined effect of speed fluctuation and noise variation. In order to solve the above problems, a fault diagnosis model of order track variational stacked autoencoder (OTV-SAE) for complex working conditions is proposed. Firstly, a ridge line extraction method based on time-frequency energy is proposed to solve the problem of high dependence of order tracking method on tachometer. Then, the advantages of order spectrum (signal regularity and obvious features) are used to help variational autoencoder to learn noise features and generate samples containing a variety of noise features, which improves the generalization ability of training samples. Experimental results show that OTV-SAE can eliminate the influence of speed fluctuation and improve the robustness of the model to noise, and greatly improve the diagnostic accuracy of the model in complex conditions.

articleTitle: Sensitivity Analysis and Reliability Optimization Method Based on Aircraft Cabin Door Lock Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: With the gradual development of industrialization, the reliability engineering requirements of products are gradually increasing. The characteristics of high reliability and small number of samples are especially important within the aerospace field. In order to improve the reliability of the aircraft hatch lock mechanism, this paper combines support vector machine and kriging methods for failure rate calculation and sensitivity analysis, and uses Monte Carlo methods for validation. The reliability optimization is carried out through the validation results, and the design of the lock mechanism is improved, which significantly reduces the failure rate of the lock mechanism and also provides design ideas for other mechanical structures.

articleTitle: Research on Vibration Test Scheme for Screw Anti-loosening Performance Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: Under vibration conditions, the main failure mode of threaded connections is loosening. This paper analyzes the mechanical properties and anti-loosening characteristics of a certain type of cross recessed pan head screw based on the needs of the enterprise and the loosening situation in practical applications, and studies the loosening law and influence of screws under different vibration conditions. More than 80 hours of vibration tests shows: (1) Under normal vibration conditions, the tightening torque attenuation of the screw is usually stable at 30%, and it should not be judged as failure at this time. (2) The vibration test of the whole machine of the enterprise has no effect on the loosening of the screws. (3) The influence of vibration displacement on screw loosening is more obvious than that of vibration frequency. (4) Compared with the steel internal thread, the aluminum internal thread has a large dispersion of the loosening of the screw, and is easy to wear during vibration.This paper provides a reference for the determination and detection of screw looseness and process improvement

articleTitle: Construction Progress Management System of Building Group Project Based on CIM Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: The construction process of building complex projects is complex, and the construction progress is often delayed. The current construction progress management system can only manage a single link separately, ignoring the connectivity of each link in the construction of the complex project, resulting in low management efficiency. In view of the above defects, this study designed a construction schedule management system for building group projects based on CIM technology. Based on the embedded hardware architecture, the three-dimensional construction model of the building complex project is established by using BIM. After analyzing the factors affecting the construction progress, the CIM technology is used to predict the construction progress. According to the prediction results, a construction schedule scheduling model is established to manage the project schedule. In the system test, the management system using CIM technology can basically control the construction progress to meet the design requirements. The management efficiency is as high as 90% and the performance is better.

articleTitle: Accurate Recommendation Algorithm of Preschool Education Network Resources Based on Improved Decision Tree
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: Aiming at the difficulty of users obtaining preschool education network resources, a precise recommendation algorithm of preschool education network resources based on improved decision tree is proposed. The categories of effective information of preschool education network resources are adjusted by improved decision tree, combined with the reconstruction of preschool education network resources, Extract the effective information of preschool education network resources, set the weight threshold of preschool education network resources similarity through the analysis of the similarity of different preschool education network resources in the data set, calculate the weight value, obtain the similarity between preschool education network resources in the data set, obtain the distribution of the similarity between preschool education network resources, and complete the calculation of the similarity value between preschool education network resources, Through user interest modeling, an accurate recommendation algorithm for preschool education network resources is designed. The experimental results show that the accurate recommendation algorithm of preschool education network resources based on improved decision tree has good effect and performance on preschool education network resources recommendation.

articleTitle: Resource Security Allocation Algorithm of Ecological Network Curriculum in Higher Education Based on Fuzzy Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: Aiming at the resource allocation of ecological network courses in higher education, the corresponding allocation framework is constructed based on fuzzy particle swarm optimization. Because of the slow convergence speed of particle swarm optimization algorithm in the later stage, it is easy to converge in local optimization. Therefore, combined with the characteristics of resource allocation problem, particle swarm optimization algorithm is improved. The resource allocation model of ecological network courses in higher education is solved by using fuzzy particle swarm optimization algorithm under the constraints, and the resource allocation scheme is obtained. The results show that compared with the manual allocation scheme, the higher education ecological network curriculum resource allocation scheme obtained by the research algorithm has higher curriculum resource utilization efficiency and resource allocation efficiency, indicating the effectiveness of the research algorithm.

articleTitle: UAV-to-Ground Target Robust Tracking Algorithm Based on Two-Way CNN
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: In order to make the UAV equipment track the ground target accurately in the flight process, this paper proposes a UAV-To-Ground target robust tracking algorithm based on Two-Way CNN. The algorithm is based on two-way CNN architecture, and detects the visual target of UAV after solving the surf feature of the ground target image. According to the linear correction expression of the tracking parameters, the algorithm determines the performance intensity of the non maximum suppression effect of the tracking coefficient on UAV ground target parameters, and then combines the known tracking coefficient and the loss function to realize the tracking of the UAV ground target. The experimental results show that under the effect of the dual CNN network architecture, the tracking accuracy of the UAV equipment for the established ground target during flight is significantly improved, which can meet the actual application requirements.

articleTitle: Context-Awareness-Based Intelligent Accuracy Recommendation Algorithm for Business English Teaching Resources
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of intelligent recommendation of business English teaching resources, an intelligent recommendation algorithm for business English teaching resources based on situational awareness is designed. Cluster resources in advance, generate candidate queues, measure and calculate trust, filter resources by combining situational awareness and collaborative filtering, calculate user similarity, and realize intelligent recommendation of business English teaching resources. The experimental results show that the proposed recommendation algorithm can accurately recommend the required resources and spend less time.

articleTitle: Selective Kernel Prototypical Network for Few-shot Motor Fault Diagnosis with Unseen Faults
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: Motor fault diagnosis has been paid increasing attention in the academia and industry. Data-driven methods have achieved great success with massive experimental data to train the model. In industrial scenes, data sparsity is a nonnegligible problem restricting the application of these methods. Not enough data can be accessible in faulty conditions and very limited data may be obtained for some less frequently occurring faults. To tackle this few-shot learning problem, a prototypical network based on selective kernel network is proposed in this paper. One-dimensional selective kernel network is used to enhance the embedding learning ability of prototypical network based on its dynamic convolutional kernel selection mechanism. The effectiveness and superiority of the proposed method are verified on motor experimental data. Results show that the proposed method can achieve high diagnosis accuracy on unseen faults which have very few samples.

articleTitle: Delay time-based inspection and replacement optimization under Semi-Markov decision process
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: Condition-based replacement and spare part scheduling is essential to increase system reliability and reduce failure probabilities. The majority of current studies assume there are enough replacement parts to replace failed units, while neglecting delays caused by a shortage of spare components. The delay-time model generally employs two-stage failure processes, the first of which begins with a healthy condition and progresses to an unhealthy state, followed by a failure state. The failure process is described using a semi-Markov model, where the sojourn time in each stage follows the Erlang distribution. The state of the system is detected at some discrete equidistant epochs, and an order action is triggered once the accumulated deterioration reaches the pre-specified limit. The system is then put on hold until the spare part arrives. The goal is to reduce the operational cost by optimizing the inspection interval, and then using a semi-Markov decision process to calculate system performance indices. Finally, under the delay-time model, a numerical example is provided to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed optimization model.

articleTitle: A Novel Domain Adaptation Health State Diagnosis Method for a 3-PRR Planar Parallel Manipulator
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: Domain adaptation strategies have been widely applied in the field of intelligent health state diagnosis as a promising technique for alleviating model performance degradation caused by feature distribution differences. However, most of existing studies focuses more on the key functional components (such as bearings, gears, and so on). To further extend its application, a novel domain adaptation approach, named capsule embedded convolutional auto-encoder (CE-CAE) network, is constructed and applied to a 3-PRR planar parallel manipulator. First, benefiting from the dynamic routing update mechanism, a capsule layer is employed at the end of the encoder to avoid the loss of valid information. Following that, encoding and decoding processes are implemented to extract deep coding features. Finally, a joint maximum mean discrepancy (JMMD) metric is adopted to simultaneously align the marginal and conditional distributions between the source and target domains, thereby enabling the extraction of common domain features. A total of four transfer scenarios are established for testing. Experimental results show that the proposed CE-CAE model has excellent diagnosis performance and transferability across working conditions.

articleTitle: Enhanced Dictionary Design-based Sparse Classification Scheme Towards Machinery Intelligent Diagnostics
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: Machinery intelligent diagnostics is taking on a key role in enabling smart operation and maintenance of modern industrial equipment, especially in the prospective era of industry 4.0. Sparse representation-assisted intelligent diagnostics (SR-ID) framework shows great prospects to obtain promising diagnostic performance without designing complex deep network architectures compared with deep learning models. However, the existing SR-ID approach still suffers to obtain superior and robust diagnostic accuracy in noisy circumstances. To tackle this challenge, a novel enhanced dictionary design-based sparse classification (EDD-SC) scheme is developed in this study, which comprises of enhanced dictionary design and intelligent health diagnostics. Firstly, the periodic similarity of vibration data is leveraged to fuse the physical priori information with dictionary design, thus enhancing reconstruction capability of EDD-SC. Secondly, a minimal sparse approximation error strategy is developed to accomplish superior health diagnosis. The presented EDD-SC scheme has been detailedly verified on the challenging task of planetary drivetrain fault diagnostics, showing that EDD-SC can yield robust and superior diagnostic results even in comparison to several state-of-the-art benchmarks. This work has provided a promising framework and paved a new direction towards robust data-driven machinery intelligent diagnostics.

articleTitle: Research on Hardware Based Fault Diagnosis Model of Airborne Fuel Pump
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: Fault diagnosis model for airborne products hardware model of transplantation difficult, the problem of low efficiency of hardware and software collaborative implementation, combined with airborne scenario performance requirements of the model, based on the hardware and software collaborative design and function module partition method, is proposed for the hardware of the onboard fuel pump fault diagnosis model and implementation method. Firstly, combined with the characteristics of hardware implementation of the model, a hardware-oriented fault diagnosis process for airborne fuel pump is designed. Secondly, the hardware and software modules of the airborne fuel pump fault diagnosis model are divided according to the data flow in the model, and the model is realized and optimized on FPGA by IP core and high-level synthesis (HLS) method, and the design and implementation of the airborne fuel pump fault diagnosis system is completed. The experimental results show that the proposed fault diagnosis model can improve the computational efficiency by 33.56 times compared with the common processor, which provides a solution for model transplantation and hardware realization and optimization in the hardware of fault diagnosis model for airborne components.

articleTitle: Research on 3D Virtual Image Robust Reconstruction Algorithm Based on Visual Communication
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: Three-dimensional virtual image reconstruction is a research hotspot in the field of image processing. Aiming at improving the effect of three-dimensional image reconstruction, this paper proposes a three-dimensional virtual image reconstruction algorithm based on visual communication. The proposed algorithm firstly constructs a three-dimensional virtual image visual communication model, and uses the calibrated camera equipment to collect the initial images from multiple dimensions. Secondly, through the steps of image degradation, distortion correction, denoising and segmentation, the preprocessing of the initial image is completed. Finally, the edge information of 3D virtual image is extracted, and the 3D virtual image is reconstructed by feature reconstruction. The experimental results show that the signal-to-noise ratio of the three-dimensional virtual image reconstructed by the proposed algorithm is improved by 1.466, and the matching coefficient with the actual scene is significantly improved, that is, the quality of the three-dimensional virtual image reconstructed by the optimized algorithm is higher.

articleTitle: Cascading failure analysis and robustness assessment of the operational system and electric power system based on dependent network
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: In the long-lasting war game, a continuous and stable power supply is of significant importance for giving full play to its superiority. Once the electric power system is attacked, the cascading effect will arise which caused faults to spread within the power network and between operation networks, and eventually lead to large-scale power outages. As a result, the operation loops will rupture and the operational system effectiveness will decline dramatically. In this paper, according to the characteristics of power network and combat network, a cascading failure model of heterogeneous interdependent network considering load characteristics is proposed from the perspective of complex network dependency, and a vulnerability assessment index for electric power system-operation networks(E-O) coupling networks is proposed based on the degree of network survival and operational system effectiveness. Finally, the cascading failure process and vulnerability of E-O coupling networks under different attack strategies are simulated and verified by a modified IEEE 39-bus power system. The results show that the proposed dependent network model of the E-O coupling system can reflect the characteristics and reveal failure rules of the E-O coupling system.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Operation and Maintenance System of Urban Rail Transit Vehicles Based on PHM Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: Based on the current situation of rail operation and maintenance of urban rail transit, combined with the technical system of fault diagnosis and health management (PHM), the operation and maintenance requirements of urban rail transit vehicles are investigated in depth. Due to the feasibility and superiority of PHM technology in rail operation and maintenance management, an intelligent operation and maintenance system for urban rail transit vehicles based on PHM technology is designed. Through PHM technology framework, the key hardware of the system is designed. Based on the hardware system, the vehicle information management module, operation day plan management module, data preprocessing module, health status identification module, operation and maintenance decision module and construction operation management module are established. The results show that the effectiveness of the designed system is proved through functional and performance tests, which provides solutions for the intelligent operation and maintenance of urban rail transit vehicles, and improves the safety and economy of operation and maintenance.

articleTitle: Edge Computing Node Robust Deployment Method Based on Improved Particle Swarm Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: In order to better meet the requirements of node deployment method, a node deployment method of edge computing based on improved particle swarm optimization algorithm is proposed. Based on the improved particle swarm optimization algorithm, the node distribution model of edge computing is constructed, and the node distribution structure is optimized. The node distribution algorithm of edge computing is designed, which simplifies the deployment process of edge computing nodes. The experiment proves that the node deployment method of edge computing based on improved particle swarm optimization algorithm has high practicability and fully meets the research requirements.

articleTitle: PHM Architecture Design Of Flight Control System Based On MBSE
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the PHM architecture design of the current flight control system is not standardized, incomplete and immature, this paper adopts model-based system engineering to further standardize the design process of the PHM architecture of the flight control system, and establishes the PHM system architecture model with perfect function and reasonable structure based on MBSE. The advanced PHM technology is unified with the flight control system, which provides the functional structure foundation for the PHM architecture integration of the flight control system. The design of the PHM architecture of the flight control system based on MBSE makes the design of the PHM architecture of the flight control system model, which can realize rapid iterative update and knowledge sharing, and ensure that the design problems are found in advance, and the work efficiency is greatly improved.

articleTitle: Design of Network Teaching Resource Security Integration Algorithm Based on Multi-Dimensional Association Rules
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the uneven distribution of network teaching resources leads to the long integration time, a network teaching resource integration algorithm based on multi-dimensional association rules is designed. This paper constructs a resource index model based on multi-dimensional association rules by calculating the support degree of the feature set of network teaching resources, mining network teaching resources, and preprocessing the mined resource data. According to the verification and conversion results of network teaching resources, the standard conversion format is used to obtain the teaching resources with unified format. This paper mainly uses inversion calculation tools to calculate the resource distribution center of gravity, uses analytic hierarchy process to determine the resource weight vector, calculates the difference between different resources according to the analysis matrix, and integrates the network teaching resources according to the difference. The experimental results show that the shortest integration time of the algorithm is 5s, which shows that the use of multidimensional association rules can shorten the integration time and improve the integration efficiency.

articleTitle: Robust Design of Online Psychological Counseling System for College Students Based on Mobile Wireless Network
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: The traditional way of psychological counseling is to have face-to-face communication with psychological counseling teachers at a specific time and place. It is difficult to meet the development needs of information and intelligence due to the limitations of time and place. In order to solve these shortcomings of the traditional psychological counseling mode, this paper puts forward the design method of College Students' online psychological counseling system based on mobile wireless network, optimizes the system hardware structure combined with mobile wireless network technology, and improves the system software function and operation process. Finally, experiments show that the performance of College Students' online psychological counseling system based on mobile wireless network obviously meets the current research requirements, It effectively solves the problems of traditional methods and fully meets the research requirements.

articleTitle: Non-parametric Multi Self-Attention Temporal Convolutional Network for Probabilistic Remaining Useful Life Prediction
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: Massive condition monitoring (CM) data from industrial systems has increased the usability of data-driven methods in prognostics. Remaining useful life (RUL) prediction plays a vital role in helping to improve system reliability and to reduce system risks. However, most of existing data-driven methods for RUL prediction only support point estimation and cannot adaptively extract information from different system features and time periods, but it is important to provide probabilistic RUL prediction results in practice. In this context, we propose a deep learning-based probabilistic RUL prediction framework with multi self-attention mechanisms. It is able to weight CM data in two dimensions and predict the probability density of the target RUL. Specifically, based on the multi self-attention mechanisms, the proposed framework can adaptively extract useful information from both time dimension and feature dimension by weighting measurements from multiple in-suit sensors. Then, a temporal convolution network with the shared weights is applied to feature extraction of the CM data. A non-parametric method is used to obtain a confidence interval (CI) of the target RUL with aleatoric uncertainty. The performance of the proposed framework is evaluated via a public turbofan CM dataset. The results show that the proposed framework can output high-accuracy CI for RUL prediction.

articleTitle: Remaining useful life prediction of rotating machinery based on a multi-scale separable convolutional network
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: The remaining useful life (RUL) prediction models of rotating machinery based on deep learning usually take the data from different sensors as their input. However, these models cannot effectively consider the multi-scale natures of degraded features and lack explicit learning mechanisms, thus compromising the accuracy and generalization of prediction models. This paper proposes a multi-scale separable convolutional network (MSSCN) model to track the degradation state of rotating machinery, which can consider the cross-channel correlations at multiple scales and process feature recalibrations. Firstly, multiple parallel separable convolutional channels are employed to extract the degradation features of different scales from the original signals. Secondly, a multi-scale convolution mechanism and the squeeze and excitation (SE) units are used to effectively integrate these degraded features and enhance informative feature maps but suppress useless ones. Finally, the automatically learned high-level representations are input to the regression layer to predict the RUL of a rotating machinery. The proposed MSSCN model was validated with the 2010 PHM tool wear dataset. The experimental results demonstrate that the MSSCN model has better prediction accuracy and application potential in RUL prediction of rotating machinery.

articleTitle: Design of Aero-Engine Simulation Demonstration System Based on 3D Virtual Software
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: In order to avoid excessive power consumption of aero-engine equipment and realize effective protection of the application ability of engine components, an aero-engine simulation demonstration system based on three-dimensional virtual software is designed. After connecting the client server and LAN equipment as required, the system application platform is built by establishing system modules and packaging processing. Then use 3DS Max 3D modeling software to build a mathematical constraint model. After starting the engine, calculate the thrust rod angle and judge whether it is in the reverse thrust state. On the premise of known throttle thrust rod angle and flight environment parameters, the performance parameters of the engine are analyzed. Finally, the aero-engine simulation demonstration is completed by combining all levels of hardware equipment. The experimental results show that after the application of the system, the power signal consumed by the engine components in a unit time can be well controlled, which meets the practical application requirements of effectively ensuring the operating capacity of the engine components.

articleTitle: Personalized Accurate Recommendation Algorithm of Ideological and Political Teaching Multimedia Resources Based on Mobile Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: The currently used resource recommendation algorithm mainly recommends resources according to the user's preference for a tag class, ignoring the relationship between user preferences and needs and learning scenarios under mobile learning, resulting in poor efficiency and accuracy of recommended resources. In order to improve the shortcomings of the algorithm, this paper studies the personalized recommendation algorithm of Ideological and political teaching multimedia resources based on mobile learning. By constructing the map of Ideological and political teaching knowledge, this paper analyzes the correlation between resources. The diagnosis result of students' cognitive level is one of the characteristics of personalized recommendation. Mobile learning devices are used to collect data, calculate and perceive mobile learning scenarios. By improving the collaborative filtering technology, the teaching resources of Ideological and political courses can be personalized recommended. In the algorithm experiment, the average absolute error of the algorithm recommendation is relatively reduced by about 14.67%, the recommendation efficiency is higher, and the personalized recommendation effect is better.

articleTitle: Corrected RUL-Based Maintenance Policy for Degrading Systems Under Random Failure
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: This paper develops a corrected remaining useful life (RUL) based maintenance policy for continuous monotonically degenerate systems under random failure. The maintenance policy proposes a correction factor that follows a general distribution to comprehensively consider the potential errors in RUL prognostics. A Weibull proportional hazards model (PHM) is applied to jointly model the degradation state data and service age to directly describe the failure rate of the system. The degradation state of the system is regarded as a time-varying covariate and characterized by a Gamma process. According to the established PHM, the closed-form expressions for the probability density function and cumulative distribution function of RUL are derived. A corrected RUL can be obtained by considering a stochastic correction factor in the prognostics. This work considers a corrected RUL-based maintenance policy, which makes decisions according to an optimal control limit. The optimization problem is established and solved in a semi-Markov decision process (SMDP) framework with the goal of minimizing the long-run expected average cost per unit time. The effectiveness of the proposed method is illustrated by a numerical example.

articleTitle: Intelligent Stable Monitoring Algorithm of Students' Online Learning Behavior Based on User Portrait
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: In the monitoring of students’ online learning behavior, the accurate capture rate of learning behavior has been low due to the complex actions of students. An intelligent monitoring algorithm of students’ online learning behavior based on user portraits is designed. This paper collects student data from five aspects: demographic attributes, academic attributes, behavior habits, interests and hobbies, and psychological attributes, and constructs student user portraits. The deep perception model of online learning behavior is designed from two levels of face recognition and emotion perception to implement the deep perception of students’ online learning behavior. According to the perception results, the online learning behavior is monitored intelligently through three stages: before learning, during learning and after learning, so as to realize the intelligent monitoring of students’ online learning behavior. The algorithm is tested. The test results show that the designed algorithm has a high accurate capture rate for learning behavior of all grades, and the designed algorithm has a high learning efficiency and a good learning effect.

articleTitle: Accuracy Recommendation Algorithm of Preschool Education Distance Teaching Course Based on Improved K-Means
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: In the distance learning module of preschool education, the improved K-means clustering is used to process the distance learning course of preschool education. In this paper, the characteristics of pre-school distance education courses are mined, and the scoring characteristics of different pre-school distance education courses are calculated. Based on the similarity matrix of distance learning courses in preschool education, this paper predicts the user's evaluation of distance learning courses in preschool education. By introducing the user's preference for the pre-school distance learning courses, the collaborative filtering of pre-school distance learning courses is completed. According to the connection between user's interest and distance learning courses, the shortest path between keywords and user's interest in distance learning courses of pre-school education is used. According to the user's preference, the recommendation list of distance learning courses in preschool education is predicted. By recommending the most similar distance education courses to the users, the recommendation of distance education courses for preschool education is realized. Experimental results show that the proposed RMSE of this method can reach 0.95, and the recommended accuracy is greater than 80%, and even the highest accuracy is 99%

articleTitle: Research on Composite Impact Fault Identification Algorithm Based on Improved MLP and Single Sensor Data
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: In the actual complex industrial environment, as an important part of mechanical equipment gear box in variable speed, variable load operation environment after a long time of work may appear compound failure -- gear, bearing failure. However, due to the influence of mechanical equipment structure design and other factors, it is usually not possible to install sensors near every important component to perceive its health status, and only a few vibration sensors can be installed in a few locations. Therefore, it is very important to identify and diagnose faults of multiple components through sensor data of a few locations. In this paper, several improved MLP neural network models are proposed to diagnose and classify gear and bearing faults using single sensor data, and the model is verified and analyzed by independent experimental data sets.

articleTitle: Stable Integration Method of English Multimedia Teaching Resources Based on Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: In order to improve the integration effect of English teaching resources, a method of Integrating English multimedia teaching resources based on particle swarm optimization is proposed. The integration platform of teaching resources is constructed, and particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to identify the characteristics of teaching resources. The classification management of teaching resources is realized according to the feature recognition method to ensure the effect of teaching information integration. The experimental results show that the proposed teaching resource integration effect has high adaptability and can fully meet the requirements of resource integration.

articleTitle: ChebNet-based Online Health Monitoring for Diesel Propulsion System
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: As an important means of marine traffic, the safety of ships has always been the focus of attention. The structure of the ship is complex and it is composed of multiple subsystems. The problems of each subsystem will affect the ship’s normal operation, and even lead to serious consequences. Therefore, it is an important task to carry out health monitoring on the main subsystems or main components of the ship, which helps to alarm in time when problems happen. This paper takes the intake and exhaust system of the ship propulsion system as an example, sorts out the data collected by multiple sets of sensors arranged on the system, such as temperature and pressure difference, and excavates the correlation between the data to build the graph, and then uses the graph convolutional neural network to process it efficiently to complete the task of predicting the change trend of the data. When the data’s change trend is abnormal, the system will be checked or maintained in time to prevent accidents and achieve the goal of health monitoring. In this paper, three different graph convolutional neural networks are used to predict the graph. After comparison, a method that is most suitable for this data set is obtained. It shows high efficiency and good accuracy in the prediction task. It plays an important role in monitoring the health status of the intake and exhaust system of the ship propulsion system.

articleTitle: Badminton Trajectory Accurate Tracking and Positioning Method Based on Machine Vision
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: Aiming at the poor effect of badminton trajectory tracking and positioning, a badminton trajectory tracking and positioning method based on machine vision is proposed.
