Combine machine vision technology to collect and recognize the characteristic image of badminton trajectory, calculate the change route of badminton trajectory based on the force characteristics of badminton, and finally realize the goal of effective tracking and accurate positioning of badminton trajectory. Finally, experiments show that the badminton trajectory tracking and positioning method based on machine vision has high practicability and fully meets the research requirements.

articleTitle: A Grouped Semi-Markov Maintenance Strategy Considering Random Effects
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: Refined maintenance decisions and health management of products is an important research direction in reliability. This study proposes a differentiation maintenance method considering individual random effects in the degradation process under periodic inspection. First, the slowly degradation products are divided into several groups according to the individual degradation differences, and the degradation models are established respectively. On this basis, a reasonable state space and maintenance decision space are constructed, the state transfer probability of the degradation process is solved. The optimal differential maintenance strategy is solved by strategy iteration under the framework of semi-Markov decision process model to minimize the unit expected cost. The GaAs taser degradation case is used as a validation and compared with the repair strategy with a fixed replacement threshold, and it is demonstrated that the proposed grouped repair strategy can reduce the cost. In addition, the effectiveness of the proposed method for newly put-in-use individuals is also verified by simulating new individual extrapolation.

articleTitle: A Monocular Visual Inertial Odometer Based on Weighted Median Pre-Integration
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: In the monocular visual inertial odometer, the graph-based optimization method is more accurate than the filter-based optimization method. However, this performance improvement comes at the cost of generating extensive calculations. So the method of pre-integrating the inertial measurement values between selected keyframes is proposed to reduce the computational effort. The existing pre-integration technology usually uses the numerical integration method of Euler integration and median integration, this method is simple to calculate, but considering the accuracy is lost in the integration process, which has an impact on the accuracy of the final positioning result. Therefore, this paper proposes a weighted median pre-integration method suitable for the monocular visual- inertial odometer, which can effectively improve the positioning accuracy of the monocular visual-inertial odometer. And the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm is proved by experimental results.

articleTitle: A Wearable Body Fat Distribution Feature Low Error Detection Algorithm Based on Kernel Density Estimation
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of wearable body fat distribution feature detection, a wearable body fat distribution feature detection algorithm based on kernel density estimation is designed. This paper collects human body data and classifies the data features. In this paper, the kernel density estimation method is used to extract the data features of body fat distribution. It judges the similarity of the data and realizes the wearable body fat distribution feature detection based on the kernel density estimation. The experimental results show that the proposed detection algorithm can accurately detect the wearable body fat distribution characteristics and meet the design requirements of the method.

articleTitle: A Prognostics Approach Based on Feature Fusion and Deep BiLSTM Neural Network for Aero-Engine
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: Aero-engines are prone to inaccurate remaining useful life prediction during operation due to the complexity of the degradation mechanism. Therefore, this paper proposes a multi-information fusion remaining useful lifetime prediction model based on simple moving average (SMA), principal component analysis (PCA) and deep bidirectional long short-term memory (DBiLSTM) neural network. Firstly, SMA is used for noise reduction of multi-dimensional degraded data of aero-engine, then PCA is used for dimensionality reduction and information fusion, finally DBiLSTM neural network model is used to predict the remaining useful life of engine for the above reduced data set, and eventually the mapping relationship between monitoring data and remaining life is obtained. This study uses the C-MAPSS aero-engine degradation dataset to experimentally validate the proposed multi-information fusion life prediction model and to compare it with other classical models and advanced methods that have emerged in recent years. The results show that the proposed method can accurately predict the remaining life under multi-dimensional degradation information, and the error and score of the prediction model are reduced up to 10.28% and 31.65% for RMSE and Score, respectively, compared with other model methods.

articleTitle: Digital model design and reliability study of supply chain in wind power industry
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: In order to effectively combine the front, middle and back ends of the wind power industry manufacturer’s business model, a comprehensive global consideration is made from the perspective of the supply chain digital model to strengthen the reliability of supply chain management. This study takes production planning as the core, and forms a new problem of closed-loop resource planning with demand → production → scheduling → demand, studies the influencing factors that affect customer demand for wind power equipment, builds a demand planning model as the scientific input basis for the production planning model; secondly, uses a linear planning model for constraint logic innovation, and takes the production plan with optimal cost scheduling as the output to achieve the company’s operating cost. The purpose of the lowest cost is achieved and the reliability of the supply chain is tested. Finally, the negative feedback key input for demand forecasting is formed through dynamic information capture. The results of the study will contribute to the development of production planning standards in the wind power industry, promote the rapid industrial development of primary and secondary suppliers in the wind power industry’s entire chain, and reduce the bullwhip effect problem in the whole industry.

articleTitle: Application Effect Robust Evaluation Algorithm of Online and Offline Hybrid Teaching Mode in Undergraduate Colleges
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: In order to improve the practical application effect of the mixed teaching mode, an application effect evaluation algorithm of online and offline hybrid teaching mode in undergraduate colleges is proposed. Firstly, the big data technology is used to collect the big data in the online and offline mixed teaching process of undergraduate colleges, and an evaluation index system is built from three dimensions to extract the required data according to the indicators. Then the association rules between the relevant data of the evaluation indicators are established to obtain the phase space distribution of the data. Finally, the constraint parameter analysis method is used to fuse the control variables and explanatory variables of the index related data to realize the online and offline mixed teaching effect evaluation. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm achieves an ideal evaluation result of online and offline mixed teaching effect, which is conducive to improving the teaching quality.

articleTitle: Multi Domain Resource Accurate Allocation Algorithm for Wireless Communication of Internet of Things Based on Chaotic Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that it is easy to fall into local minimum in the multi domain resource allocation process of wireless communication in the Internet of things, a multi domain resource allocation algorithm of wireless communication in the Internet of things based on chaotic neural network is proposed. The effects of attenuation factor and temperature fading parameters on the chaotic characteristics of chaotic neural network are analyzed, and the network parameters are selected reasonably. This paper obtains the multi domain resources of integrated Internet of things wireless communication, updates the multi domain resources, and builds a multi domain resource configuration model through relevant network parameters. In this paper, we use data mining method to obtain the multi domain resource data of wireless communication. And the parameters of the network are appropriately selected to make the neural network appear chaotic, so the resource allocation process based on the chaotic neural network is designed. Therefore, the resource allocation process based on chaotic neural network is designed. The experimental results show that the configuration results of the algorithm are consistent with the ideal configuration results, and the shortest end-to-end delay is 10 ms, and the lowest packet loss rate is 4%.

articleTitle: A Multi-Rotor UAV Track Accuracy Planning Method Based on Bidirectional Recurrent Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: Multi-rotor UAV is one of the key devices for overhead surveying, and autonomous trajectory planning capability is one of its key performances. In the practical application environment of UAV, there are complexity and uncertainty in the operating environment, which makes the trajectory planning more difficult. Therefore, a multi-rotor UAV trajectory planning method based on bidirectional recurrent neural network is proposed. According to the force situation of UAV, the dynamic model of multi rotor UAV is established firstly, and the flight environment model is established on the basis of drawing digital map. Then, according to the relevant parameters of UAV and obstacles, this study uses two-way recurrent neural network to solve the optimal trajectory planning results of UAV. The experimental data show that: the minimum delay of the track planning of this method is 2.10s, the maximum success probability of avoiding obstacles is 100%, and the minimum value of the track deviation rate is 4.75% which proves that the track planning effect of this method is better.

articleTitle: Substation Telecontrol Fast Stable Point-to-Point System Based on Naive Bayesian Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: In order to better guarantee the operation effect of substation, a substation telecontrol fast point-to-point system based on Naive Bayesian algorithm is designed. The hardware structure configuration of the system is designed, the system software function is improved, and the fast point-to-point steps of substation telecontrol are simplified. And the experiment proves that the performance of the substation telecontrol fast point-to-point system based on Naive Bayesian algorithm is significantly improved, which can better ensure the operation safety of the substation.

articleTitle: A Preliminary Study on the Application of Knowledge Graph on Aero Engine Health Management (EHM)
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: Aero-engine prognostics and health management technology are the main methods to address the operation and maintenance of complex equipment system as an aero-engine. With the development of control system and sensor technology, the monitoring data grows in huge and presents typical characteristics such as high speed, multi-source and heterogeneous, etc. The intelligent and effective analysis of the huge data is the key to health management, and knowledge graph is one of the key technologies to solve the problem that a large amount of unstructured data is not fully applied. This paper summarizes the necessity and research status of knowledge graph in aero-engine health management, and makes a preliminary exploration and outlook on the application of knowledge graph in the field of aeroengine health management.

articleTitle: Research on Stable Prediction Method of Online Learning Effect Based on Decision Tree
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: In order to better improve the efficiency of online learning, based on the current poor effect of online learning, an online learning effect prediction method based on decision tree is proposed. The decision tree algorithm simplifies the collection process of online learning behavior characteristics, constructs the prediction and evaluation index system of online learning effect, and optimizes the prediction steps of online learning effect. Finally, experiments show that the online learning effect prediction method based on decision tree has high effectiveness. When the background information and interaction time = 101-800, the prediction failure rate is up to 6.5%, which can fully meet the research requirements.

articleTitle: A Method of Ideological and Political Teaching Resource Accuracy Scheduling and Control Based on MVC Framework
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: The currently used resource scheduling methods are sorted according to the priority of demand objects, resulting in large computing load, long response delay, low load balance and waste of computing resources on some nodes. Aiming at the above problems, this paper proposes a method of scheduling and controlling ideological and political teaching resources based on MVC framework. After building the MVC framework of Ideological and political teaching resource scheduling, the controller is used to collect the teaching resource scheduling information under the framework. After the establishment of the ideological and political resources scheduling model, the Q-learning algorithm combined with the deep neural network is used to solve the model to achieve the effective scheduling and control of resources. In the experiment of scheduling method, the method under MVC framework reduces the scheduling response time by about 36.85%, improves the load balance, and makes full use of scheduling computing resources.

articleTitle: Instantaneous Rotor Speed Estimation Based on Multisynchrosqueezing Transform Time-Frequency Analysis with Vibration Signals
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: Instantaneous speed (IS) measurement is critical in working condition monitoring of rotating machinery. In view of the fact that traditional methods cannot measure the IS with high accuracy and have failed under complex working conditions such as variable speed and strong variable speed. A novel method is proposed to estimate the IS of rotor of rotating machinery accurately. At first, the collected vibration signal is preprocessed. Secondly, Multisynchrosqueezing Transform (MSST), a high time-frequency (TF) energy aggregation TF analysis method, is carried out to obtain the TF distribution. Then Viterbi ridge extraction algorithm is used to extract the instantaneous frequency (IF) from the TF domain. Finally, IS is obtained through the linear relationship between IS and IF. Comparing with different TF analysis-based methods: Short-Time Fourier Transform (STFT), Chirplet Transform (CT), Fourth-order Synchrosqueezing Transform (4-SST), Reassignment Method (RM) and Synchroextracting Transform (SET), the proposed method can estimate the IF and IS more accurately in constant and variable speed simulation experiments as well as mechanical failure comprehensive simulation (MFS) bench experiments. Moreover, the proposed method can provide higher TF energy aggregation.

articleTitle: Accurate Recommendation Algorithm of Digital Resources in Ideological And Political Mobile Teaching Based on Collaborative Filtering
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: At present, the recommendation of teaching resources only depends on the score of resource acquisition, which leads to low accuracy of recommended resources and low efficiency of recommendation algorithm. In order to improve the above defects, this paper will study the accurate recommendation algorithm of digital resources of ideological and political mobile teaching based on collaborative filtering. Through implicit and explicit mining of teaching resource data, the user's preference is calculated, and the resource recommendation data related to similar users is obtained. SCROM(Sharable Content Object Reference Model) is used to manage the digital resources of ideological and political education, and the calling process of resource content is simple. After the collaborative filtering algorithm is improved, the resources are accurately recommended according to the comprehensive score. In the test of the algorithm, the accuracy rate of resource recommendation by using the improved collaborative filtering algorithm is maintained above 75%, and the recommendation efficiency is greatly improved, with good recommendation effect.

articleTitle: Research on The Integration Algorithm of Online and Offline Hybrid Teaching Resources in Undergraduate Colleges
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of scattered resources and difficult interaction in the integration of teaching resources in Colleges and universities, this paper puts forward the research of teaching resources integration algorithm. This paper analyzes the research and application background of teaching resource integration, combines data mining technology to mine and identity the characteristics of teaching resources, constructs an evaluation algorithm for teaching resource integration, and constructs a management model for teaching resource integration. Finally, experiments prove that the online and offline hybrid teaching resource integration algorithm of undergraduate colleges has high practicality and accuracy, which fully meets the research requirements.

articleTitle: A Fast Clustering Algorithm for Hybrid Big Data Considering the Global Distribution Information of Samples
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: In view of the poor clustering accuracy of current hybrid large data fast clustering algorithms, a hybrid large data fast clustering algorithm considering global distribution information is proposed. Rough set algorithm is used to collect mixed data samples considering global distribution information of samples. The original mixed data entropy is calculated to complete the initial data partition. MapReduce is combined with the classical spectral clustering algorithm to complete the hybrid large data clustering analysis. So far, the hybrid big data clustering algorithm considering global distribution information of samples is designed. The experimental findings demonstrate that this method's clustering accuracy is comparatively high and that excellent clustering outcomes may be attained.

articleTitle: A Full Compensation System for Grounding Residual Current in Distribution Network Based on Real-Time Waveform Tracking and Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: In order to better ensure the safety of distribution network operation, a full compensation system for grounding residual current in distribution network based on real-time waveform tracking and detection is designed. The system hardware is optimized, and the equipment structure design is improved for the main circuit combined with active power filter and thyristor-controlled reactor. Based on the real-time waveform tracking detection technology, the working principle of the system is analyzed, and the characteristics of resonance suppressing power quality comprehensive compensation system for grounding residual current in the distribution network are optimized. The final simulation results show that the full compensation system of grounding residual current in distribution network based on real-time waveform tracking. At the same time, it can effectively carry out comprehensive dynamic control of harmonics and reactive power in the system, providing a basis for high-quality and energy-saving distribution networks.

articleTitle: Evaluation Algorithm of Vocational Undergraduate Education Quality Based on Entropy Weight Method
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: The conventional evaluation method is to give weight according to the subjective feelings of experts and scholars, and often different people have different judgments or even different views on the weight of a certain index, and the evaluation results will lack recognition at this time. This paper designs an evaluation algorithm of vocational undergraduate education quality based on entropy weight method. According to the evaluation principles, the evaluation system is constructed and the evaluation data is collected. The entropy weight method is used to calculate the index weight, and the result is multiplied with the decision matrix to obtain the optimal solution and the worst solution of the index, calculate the closeness between the optimal solution and the evaluation value, and take it as the evaluation result. The experimental results show that the algorithm can accurately evaluate the quality of vocational undergraduate education and provide reference for educational decision-making.

articleTitle: Fluid Simulation and Reliability Evaluation for the Spacecraft Multilayer Insulation in the Rapid Pressure Relief Process of the Powered Phase
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: The multilayer insulation (MLI) fixed on the spacecraft surface as the most important thermal control approach may be damaged during the rapid pressure relief of the powered phase. The stress inconformity on each thin film may cause MLI failure with too much fluid pressure due to the rapid pressure relief. In this paper, the stress uniformity on the thin films in MLI was studied. The three-dimensional slice model of MLI was established. The stress distribution on each thin film in the rapid pressure relief process was analyzed by using computational fluid dynamics (CFD) method and the result showed the fluid stress on the thin film increases gradually from the inside to the outside. In consideration of the short time of the rapid pressure relief process during the powered phase, the steady model was adopted to product the reliability evaluation for the MLI where the fault is caused by transient stresses loading into the system. The result indicated that the reliability achieved to 0.955 when the MLI is sewed by 90mm×90mm. The simulation methods approached in this paper can be applied in the fluid stress analysis for other thermal control products and it can provide an effective technical approach for the environmental adaptability and reliability evaluation in the powered phase.

articleTitle: Local Sharing Method of Accounting Information Based on Optimized Security FOA Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: In order to improve the efficiency of accounting information management and realize the local sharing of accounting information, this paper proposes a local sharing method of accounting information based on optimized fruit fly optimization algorithm (FOA). On the basis of constructing the accounting information sharing model by using the optimized FOA algorithm, the importance evaluation index of local accounting information sharing is set up. Then, in the value identification process of accounting information sharing, FOA information sharing management process is improved according to the needs of different levels of information users, and then the local sharing of accounting information is realized in a modular manner. Experiments show that this method has high practicability, its sharing process is less time-consuming, and the basic carrier capacity of the sharing platform is improved.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Control Security Threats of Unmanned Aerial Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: Modern weapons and equipment represented by unmanned aerial systems (UAS) are developing from mechanization to automation and intelligence, and gradually have anthropomorphic or humanoid intelligence. It is difficult for the existing security defense technology to meet the needs of intelligent control of UAS for security protection capability, active attack capability and countermeasure capability. This study proposes a multi-step attack method for UAS intelligent control responding to treats to UAS, considering attacks on its sensors, on-board computer and control bus. Firstly, this dissertation mainly examines the control methods of UAV control systems. It then describes the UAS intelligent control process, next analyses the threats to UAS intelligent control systems, and finally proposes a multi-step attack against UAS intelligent control and looks at the future development of security defense for UAS intelligent control.

articleTitle: Automatic Detection System of Substation Relay Protection Device Based on Failure Density Function
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: Because the traditional substation relay protection device automatic detection system has the problem of inaccurate detection results, the substation relay protection device automatic detection system based on the failure density function is designed. The hardware structure of the system is designed by the high-performance C8051F040 single chip microcomputer and the insulation detection sensor. On the basis of the system hardware design, the system software function is optimized. According to the relay protection current setting calculation flow, the genetic algorithm is derived to construct the failure density function, and the automatic detection of the relay protection device in the substation is carried out, Through the hardware design and software design of the system, the design of automatic detection system of substation relay protection device based on genetic algorithm is completed. The experimental results show that the designed system can detect the insulation voltage of positive and negative bus more accurately and has high practicability in the practical application process, which fully meets the research requirements.

articleTitle: Online Exam Data Security Encryption Algorithm Based on ASP.NET
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: In order to improve the security of online examination data and the fairness in the examination process, this paper describes a secure encryption algorithm of online examination data based on ASP.NET. The overall structure and functional modules of the system are proposed based on the actual situation Net technology and SQL back-end database, with the following functions: test question database management, online examination, computer automatic marking, score analysis, test paper analysis and user management. The ADO.NET component of ASP. NET is used to realize the connection between the web page and the database. The matching of fields is used to realize the function of student login and super user management login. The statement realizes the function of analyzing the test taker's detailed results and analyzing the test paper. The characteristics, advantages and disadvantages of the system are summarized, and the future development and application prospects are prospected.

articleTitle: Hybrid Al Framework for Remote Patient Heart Failure Risk Prediction
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: Heart failure is a lethal disease with a high risk of death. Once it is diagnosed, it cannot be cured definitively. Continuous attention needs to be given to such patients in both hospital and home environment. Due to the lack of measurement and risk analysis at home, the chance of early intervention is dramatically reduced. This research aims to offer a hybrid AI-based approach for patients to monitor and assess their daily risk at home. Highly personalized AI models are trained with continuous data stream from wearable devices and demographic information. The personalized risk assessment is based on individual’s benchmark of the daily routine and bio pattern. Also, the rule-based algorithms are developed based on clinical well-established thresholds. This hybrid approach yields 87.5% accuracy. Our approach can provide a cost-efficient method for at-home patients’ heart failure prediction.

articleTitle: RUL-centered postponed maintenance planning under random failure threshold
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: State-driven asset management, which fully considers the health state evolution pattern, is essential to improve the operation performance and reduce the downtime loss of industrial systems such as railway vehicles, wind power equipment and nuclear equipment. A common phenomenon in health management is the uncertainty (improvisation and/or cognition) of degradation-based failure threshold. This paper solves this problem by scheduling a new postponed replacement policy to capture the distribution characteristics of fault threshold. The health evolution is described by a generalized stochastic process, and its lifetime model is established by combining the randomness of both deterioration increment and threshold. A reliability threshold is set to determine whether preventive replacement (PR) is available. If the predicted reliability is lower than the threshold, PR will be postponed following the expectation of the residual service lifetime adjusted by a postponement factor, so as to enhance the asset availability. The objective is to minimize the long-run operational cost by jointly optimizing the inspection interval, reliability threshold and postponement factor. A case study of bearing health management demonstrates that the proposed policies and models outperform some conventional maintenance policies in availability enhancement and cost reduction.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Prognostic Model based on Bayesian Deep Learning Network and Uncertainty Quantification for Roller Bearings
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: Good prognostics and health management (PHM) technology has been proven to provide safe and reliable operation for mechanical or electrical devices or equipment-critical components in industry. Using the collected vibration signals, many data-driven prediction approaches show good potential for the remaining useful life (RUL) prediction for roller bearings, but an open problem is still to develop a more accurate and practical prognosis method and further extent to the whole machinery. However, for the same bearing, the prediction results can differ due to many uncertainties, such as operation condition, model inaccuracy, noisy signal. Inspired by the Bayesian theorem and deep learning, a hybrid prediction model based on the Bayesian neural network and bidirectional long short-term memory (LSTM) is presented for bearing prognostics in this paper. The Bayesian machine learning and deep learning work together to provide accurate predictions with uncertainty quantification. In the experiment, the vibration datasets from the platform PRONOSTIA (PHM2012) are applied to the hybrid model. The experimental results and comparison with the LSTM indicate that the hybrid network provides more accurate prediction results and 95% confidence interval for roller bearings.

articleTitle: Visual Communication Brand Design Prototype Structure Robust Optimization Algorithm Based on Virtual Simulation Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of many constraint variables and complex interference in the design process of the visual communication brand design prototype, and to improve the running quality of the brand design prototype, a structural optimization algorithm of the visual communication brand design prototype was proposed based on virtual simulation technology. This paper builds a prototype structure model based on virtual simulation technology, determines the visual communication form of the brand design prototype, and sets the optimization constraints of the brand design prototype structure. Then, by calculating the structural parameters of the prototype of the visual communication brand design, the components such as bearings, valves, and adjustment devices of the prototype were optimized. Through the virtual assembly of multiple components, the optimized results of the prototype structure of the visual communication brand design are obtained. Finally, the advanced nature of the method is proved by experiments. Compared with the traditional structural optimization algorithm, the design algorithm shows that the structural deformation of the prototype is reduced by 4.547mm, the structural stability coefficient is increased by 0.187, and the optimization speed is significantly improved.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Feature Selection Approach Based on ReliefF-FC-SS Algorithm for Multi-feature Data
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: Nowadays, the extensive application of PHM technology makes mechanical equipment more precise and automated, but the massive data generated during the operation also significantly increase the difficulty of evaluating equipment operation status. In order to accurately and efficiently identify the categories of equipment operating states, it is necessary to extract a high-quality feature subset from the original high- dimensional feature space. Therefore, this paper improves the traditional ReliefF algorithm by introducing feature correlation and stepwise selection, and proposes ReliefF-FC-SS algorithm. To verily the performance of ReliefF-FC-SS algorithm, this paper applies three classical feature selection approaches and the approach based on ReliefF-FC-SS algorithm to nine public datasets. The experimental results show that the proposed approach can capture more information with fewer features on the premise of ensuring classification accuracy.

articleTitle: A Fault Diagnosis Method Based on Digital Twin and Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: A dynamic adversarial adaptive bearing fault diagnosis method driven by a combination of simulation and data is proposed to solve the problem of low diagnostic accuracy of rolling bearings due to the scarcity of fault data samples and complex service conditions in real industrial scenarios. Firstly, a four-degree-of-freedom dynamics simulation model was proposed for the rapid generation of bearing fault characteristics with a well-defined time-frequency domain. Subsequently, the commonalities and differences between the measured data distribution and the dynamics simulation signal were explored. Finally, a dynamic adversarial adaptive network that can extract invariant features in the hidden domain and automatically align the distribution of data in the source domain of the simulation and the data to be diagnosed in the target domain is developed. A rolling bearing fault diagnosis simulation experiment was designed, which used the dynamic model to generate the simulated signal with label information and the measured signal without label information to train the neural network. The classification and recognition of unlabeled samples are completed. The results show that the simulated signals contain information on the characteristics of bearing faults, which can characterise real bearing data. Moreover, the proposed dynamic adversarial adaptive network can achieve more accurate fault diagnosis of bearings.

articleTitle: Fault diagnosis of rotating machinery on the basis of improved local mean decomposition and shift - invariant dictionary learning
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: Affected by periodic nonstationary and complex mechanical background noise of fault vibration signal, the traditional fault diagnosis methods suffer from time shift-variant noise interference and false components, which can result low efficiency and accuracy of fault diagnosis. Therefore, a novel shift-invariant improved local mean decomposition (SI2LMD) fault diagnosis method is proposed to extract the periodic sparse fault impulsive features from component signal adap-tively. In this method, firstly, based on the constructed complex Morlet atom dictionry, the nov-el scheme can adaptively extract latent sparse information and periodic impulsive features in accordance with the SIDL method, which can suppress the background noise and nonstationary shift-variant characteristics. Then, the improved LMD method is used to decompose the learned feature into the AM-FM components, and the novel orthogonality criterion is adopted to avoid over-decomposition and false components. Finally, the fault feature is extracted from the opti-mal component. This method is a natural data-driven method, it does not require priori knowledge on the signal and need to determine the number of components, which is compre-hensively adaptive and flexible for signal decomposition. Furthermore, a numerical simulation signal is used to explore the accuracy of this proposed method; the vibration signal of rolling bearing and gearbox is used to verify the performance of this novel method. Results show that the proposed method outperforms the traditional method.

articleTitle: Research on the mechanism and mitigation method of a shaker abnormal shock caused by gain knob fault and ground interference
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: Electromagnetic shaker is an important test equipment to evaluate the environmental adaptability and reliability of aerospace products. Although the abnormal shock phenomenon of shakers is relatively rare, it will cause damage to both the equipment and products once it occurs, and the consequences are relatively serious. In this paper, an abnormal shock phenomenon of shaker is reported. A plausible cause is proposed as that the gain knob is aging and has bad contact failure during turning operation, which converts the ground interference signal into pulse signal and abnormally amplified by the power amplifier. There are some special findings through a series of experiments investigations, for instance, the bad contact failure of gain knob has an acceleration response 9.7 times of fault-free gain knob; the maximum shock acceleration peak obtained in abnormal shock reproduction experiment is about 71g (about 135g<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">P-P</inf>), the peak value of abnormal voltage signal entering power amplifier is 1.36V; abnormal shock phenomenon can be reproduced with 100% probability in the verification experiment under constant voltage interference, which indicates that the constant voltage component in the interference signal plays a major role; and a linear relationship between the ground interference signal and the acceleration can be fitted. As a mitigation measure, a signal isolator installed between the controller and the remote-control box can effectively alleviate the abnormal shock phenomenon, and reduce the shock acceleration to only 1.7% of that without the signal isolator.

articleTitle: Multi-period maintenance equipment investment optimization of railway freight train wheels
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: The transformation of the maintenance mode of railway freight trains prompts maintenance companies to upgrade the existing maintenance equipment. In order to avoid the huge risks associated with fixed asset investment, it is of great significance to steadily promote the upgrading of maintenance equipment. In this paper, the mixed-integer linear programming model is used to minimize the investment cost of the enterprise, and the maintenance equipment is purchased in batches and steps. Based on the reliability function, the failure information of parts is transformed into maintenance demand, and the sensitivity analysis is carried out on parameters of maintenance demands and equipment market prices. Finally, based on the case of a maintenance enterprise, the equipment purchasing strategy in different periods is formulated.

articleTitle: Knowledge representation and application of cloud data center fault diagnosis based on Knowledge Map
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: The cloud data center of large companies are facing the problems of rapid growth of object scale and the topological relationship of operation and maintenance objects changing from static to dynamic. Based on the sorting out of the cloud data center fault diagnosis knowledge structure, this paper proposes to integrate knowledge and data through a large number of rules, and defines various entities and relationships in the cloud data center operation and maintenance, the cloud data center fault diagnosis knowledge map is constructed. Through the construction and application of the cloud data center operation and maintenance knowledge map, the practicability of the fault diagnosis knowledge map defined in this paper in the operation and maintenance knowledge management and application is verified.

articleTitle: Aeroengine Robust Component Model Design Based on 3D Virtual Design
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: Aero engine is the focus of aero power research and development. Due to its complex structure, long development cycle and high scientific research investment, the cost and risk of engine test are high, and the advantages of 3D virtual design are reflected. For this reason, the aeroengine component model based on 3D virtual design is designed. This paper deeply analyzes the aeroengine exterior components, applies the 3D virtual technology to realize the 3D virtual visualization of aeroengine exterior components, and then establishes the exterior component model base through Virtual reality modeling language (VRML). Finally, the 3D virtual model of shape components is simplified based on Level of detail (LOD) algorithm. The experimental results show that compared with the given maximum limit, the design delay of the model in this paper is small, and the deviation between the model and the entity is small, indicating that the application performance of the model is good.

articleTitle: Hierarchical Optimal Path Optimization Method for Public Building Space Based on Improved Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of indoor optimal path planning, based on the hierarchical characteristics of public building space, a hierarchical optimal path optimization method for public building space based on improved ant colony algorithm is proposed, and the indoor hierarchical optimal path algorithm is implemented. The algorithm regards the road network and floor connections of each floor as an independent structure, and dynamically constructs a structured network model spanning two floors on a floor-by-floor basis according to the floor distribution of the stops. The proposed method uses the network model to analyze the path across floors, thereby obtaining the optimal path traversing all stops in the public building space. The experimental results show that compared with the traditional optimal path algorithm, the time efficiency of this algorithm is significantly improved when the path planning results are more reasonable.

articleTitle: Investigation of Civil Aircraft Airborne Equipment Operational FMEA
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: Operational FMEA is a work based on operational data of in-service aircraft, identifying the engineering design and engineering manufacturing related failure events among them, analysing and summarising the causes of failure among them and their corresponding equipment failure modes, functional impacts and their impact levels and other key information, deriving an updated list of failure modes and reviewing the safety and reliability work of in-service aircraft types. This paper examines the process, methods and roles of FMEA for civil aircraft airborne equipment operations from the perspective of the purpose of the work, including the methods for identifying reliability-related operational failures, the analysis methods for locating operational failures to associated equipment, the analysis methods for the FMEA corresponding to operational failures, the methods for identifying failure modes of operational failures to equipment DFMEA or The method of identifying operational failures as a complement to PFMEA, and the complementary role of operational failures to Functional Hazard Assessment (FHA) top events in aircraft safety. As an important extension and complement to the equipment FMEA work, the operational FMEA work for civil aircraft airborne equipment plays a vital role in improving the safety and reliability of aircraft, systems and equipment.

articleTitle: A Joint Optimization Method for the Cyber-Physical System Robustness based on Multi-Strategy Fusion
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: This paper established a three-layer joint optimization model for the robustness optimization problem of the Cyber-Physical System (CPS). The optimization model was oriented by System robustness and integrated two coupling mode optimization strategies, including branch addition and switching strategies. Then, a three-layer hybrid algorithm is proposed to solve the established optimization model. Finally, an application case of CPS based on the IEEE 30-bus model is taken to verily the feasibility of the proposed method and its superiority over the single optimization strategy.

articleTitle: Research on Influence of Turbine Oil Bubbles on Oil Condition Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: Turbine oil is very easy to generate a large number of air bubbles in the process of operation. Air bubbles not only have a great impact on the quality of oil and the operation of machinery, but also have a great impact on the reliability of oil online monitoring, resulting in monitoring data errors. Therefore, it is necessary to analyze the influence of air bubbles in the oil on the monitoring parameters. In this study, the dielectric constant sensor, particle contamination sensor, particle number sensor and viscosity sensor were used to study the changing law of the influence of bubbles on various characteristic parameters of oil, and make a qualitative analysis. And under the experimental conditions, the influence of temperature on the physical and chemical indicators was excluded by the temperature control method. The experimental results show that the number of air bubbles will affect the oil, and the more air bubbles, the worse the performance of the oil.

articleTitle: A Method of reducing leakage current measurement error in the automatic test system for semiconductor devices
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: With the rapid development of electronic technology, semiconductor devices as the main bottom devices of various electronic systems, its related test technology and test equipment have always been an important guarantee of system reliability. In the automatic test system for semiconductor devices, the excitation source and measuring instrument adopt source measure unit, and the signal switching device adopts relay array. When testing different unit under test, one relay in the relay array will be turned on and connected to the test circuit, and the other relays are in the off state. There will be a large impedance insulation resistance between the relay switch contacts in the off state, which will lead to the introduction of leakage current on the order of nA to μA. Because the leakage current of semiconductor devices is usually between a few nA and a few μA, it is necessary to reduce the leakage current error caused by relay insulation resistance when using the automatic test system for semiconductor devices. In order to solve the above problem, this paper puts forward three methods: the selection of relay type, the grafting of switch contact pin and the design of equipotential shielding layer, so as to reduce the leakage current error caused by the insulation resistance of the relay, and then improve the accuracy of the test results.

articleTitle: A new data fusion prediction model for low-fidelity and high-fidelity data on reliability evaluation based on joint parameters sampling
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: The high-fidelity data (HF) referring to the test data from real experiments can more accurately reflect the real performance indicators of the workpieces for reliability analysis in engineering. Due to the limited cost, enough HF data is difficult to be collected to meet the requirement of reliability analysis. Alternatively, a large amount of low-fidelity (LF) experimental data from simulation experiments can be integrated with HF data to achieve reliability estimates with high precision. Existing literatures have studied this problem and made some progress, but the model is rather complicated and the solving efficiency is limited. Therefore, a new data fusion prediction model on reliability evaluation is introduced by Gaussian process (GP) and Bayesian theory. The key idea is to describe the LF and HF response models, respectively, with the same regression parameter and GP correlation parameter. Furthermore, the joint parameters sampling is adopted to estimate the unknown parameters and predict the reliability based on the hybrid Markov chain Monte Carlo algorithm. It is demonstrated through an illustrative example on the Nonlinear oscillation workpiece that the proposed model and sampling methods are flexible and efficient.

articleTitle: 3D Sensor Based On Flatness Detection Algorithm For Cell Phone Back Cover Bezel Error
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: In order to improve the efficiency of flatness detection for the back cover of mobile phone, a new flatness error detection algorithm is proposed in this paper. Firstly, based on the original data scanned by 3D line laser sensor, Principal Components Analysis(PCA) algorithm was used to calculate the feature normal vector of the maximum surface of the back cover of the mobile phone, and the plane was fitted Secondly, the point cloud data is rotated according to the Angle of the frame. Finally, the height difference between each point on the frame and the fitted plane is obtained by plane fitting. The results show that compared -with the least square method, this method is more stable and has higher accuracy.

articleTitle: A deep reinforcement learning method for replacement optimization of aero-engine
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: Aero-engine is an important part of aircraft, its health state directly determines the safety of aircraft operation. Therefore, how to find the best replacement time for aero-engine before failure has become a crucial problem. This paper proposes an optimization algorithm for aero-engine replacement strategy based on deep reinforcement learning. The Gamma process is used to simulate the natural degradation of the aero-engine, and the homogeneous Poisson distribution is used to simulate the random shock of the external environment. The degradation process of aero-engines in the real service environment is simulated by integrating natural degradation and random shock. The replacement optimization of aero-engines is modeled by Markov decision process (MDP), and the optimal replacement strategy is solved by Double Deep Q-Learning (DDQN). Through a series of experiments, it is proved that the proposed algorithm can effectively avoid the problem of dimension explosion, and find the best timing for aero-engine replacement.

articleTitle: Detection Method of Abnormal Data in Network Transmission Based on Improved Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: Based on the improvement of genetic algorithm, this paper designs a method for detecting abnormal data in network transmission. Firstly, establish a network transmission abnormal data detection framework based on improved genetic algorithm, analyze the characteristics of network transmission data, then design the network host transmission communication mode, determine the communication direction of one-way flow and two-way flow, and finally design the network transmission abnormality based on improved genetic algorithm The data detection process obtains the update process of the abnormal data detection model. The experimental results show that, compared with the two traditional methods, the nonlinear data classification of the design method is more obvious and disjoint, the nonlinear data classification effect is better, and the recall and precision rates are higher than the common detection methods.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Tilting Pad Journal Bearing Considering Base Flexibility
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: For the bearing-rotor system with flexible bearing base, the deformation of the base has important influence on the bearing lubrication performance. A lubrication analysis model of tilting pad journal bearings thinking about the flexibility of the bearing base is proposed in this paper. The fluid-structure coupling problem of lubricating oil-film and the bearing is solved by finite difference method (FDM) and finite element method (FEM). Firstly, the finite element model of the bearing pad and the bearing base is established on a three-dimensional scale. The oil-film pressure field of each pad obtained by the FDM was applied to the surface of the bearing pad to calculate the deformation of it. Then, the load capacity of pads is taken as a force which applies on the bearing base at the location corresponding to the pivot of bearing pads to get the deformation of the base. Finally, for special working condition, the oil-film thickness of bearings can be corrected by considering the deformation of pads and bearing base. The results indicate that the bearing load capacity of tilting pad bearings decreases if the deformation of the base is considered. Therefore, the flexibility of the bearing base cannot be ignored when the bearing is applied to high-speed and heavy-load occasions.

articleTitle: A Mission Reliability Modeling and Simulation Method for Software-hardware Integrated System
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: A mission reliability modeling and simulation method for software-hardware integrated systems is proposed to decouple the software and hardware of the system, by taking the system function as the traction, and referencing the related method for shared equipment, which can effectively solve the problem of mission reliability modeling and calculation of complex systems including software and hardware in engineering. This method is applicable to the equipment systems whose software and hardware are developed by independent departments, and is used for the general department to predict the system mission reliability and assign the index to the development departments.

articleTitle: Design of Unmanned System for Fish-finding and Obstacle Avoidance Based on Pixhawk
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: With China’s exploration of the sea, unmanned boats on the water are receiving more and more attention. Due to the complex situation on the water, unmanned boat obstacle avoidance still has defects. To address the above problems, this paper designs unmanned fish-finding and obstacle avoidance based on Pixhawk. The Kalman filter algorithm is used for sensor information fusion, which realizes the state estimation of the fish-finding unmanned ship. The BUG2 obstacle avoidance algorithm is used for obstacle avoidance, that optimizes the automatic obstacle avoidance function of the fish-finding unmanned ship. The fish finder is used to detect the position information of the fish, that realizes the function of the fish-finding unmanned ship tracking the fish. The PID control algorithm is used to control the driving of the ship, which makes the fish-finding unmanned ship converge to the desired course quickly and accurately. The lateral error of the vessel is within 1m. The simulation results verify the feasibility of the system, and the sea trial experiments of the unmanned fish-finding vessel prove the reliability and stability of the system.

articleTitle: Degradation Prediction Of Tool Based On Fractional Levy Prediction Model
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: As the main component of the CNC cutting process, the tool directly affects the dimensional accuracy of the machined workpiece and the reliable operation of the machine. According to studies, the prediction of degradation trends is usually based on complex models with nonlinear, non-Gaussian and long-range dependence (LRD). The novelty of this paper is that a prediction model is proposed to achieve the prediction of degradation trends by using fractional Levy-stable motion (fLsm), and using Lyapunov coefficients to determine the maximum prediction range of the degradation sequence and to ensure the reasonableness of the prediction results. Finally, the performance of the proposed method is demonstrated by comparison with support vector machine (SVM) using multi-sensor vertical mill monitoring data from the 2010 Prognostics and Health Management (PHM) Challenge.

articleTitle: A Diagnosis Method of Cleanliness Defect in Rolling Element Bearing Manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: The cleanliness defect is commonly-occurred during the manufacturing process of rolling element bearings, which reduces the defect detection accuracy and further deteriorates the noise vibration harshness of bearings. To effectively detect the cleanliness defect of ex-factory bearings, this paper presents a method based on the sliding window kurtosis indicator. It first calculates the distribution of kurtosis and the threshold-overshoot sum of the sliding window kurtosis series to assess the degree of cleanliness. After that, an indicator-sensitive parameters and the judgment threshold are adaptively selected by a Bayesian optimization algorithm. The proposed method is verified with data from the bearing manufacturing processing. The results show that the proposed method has high accuracy for identifying cleanliness of bearings.

articleTitle: Prediction of Remaining Useful Life of Aero-engine Based on Network and Similarity
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: Aeroengine is a complex system consisting of various components, which has high economic benefits and research value. Accurately evaluating the performance status of aero-engines has become a hot issue in current aero-engine research, and it plays an important role in the maintenance and storage of aero-engines. In this paper, a network model is constructed based on the aero-engine sensors data and the correlation coefficient of sensors. A method for predicting the remaining useful life (RUL) of aero-engines based on the change data of average network node strength and similarity is proposed. Through the node strength to analyze the change of the network node correlation, and the change law of the sensors network overall correlation. The RUL of aero-engines can be predicted accurately. It is found that the correlation between sensors generally increases uniformly at the end of the engine life.

articleTitle: A flexible battery capacity estimation method using a portion of charging curve
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: Accurate capacity estimation is crucial for the battery management system (BMS) on the electrical vehicle. In this work, we utilize a deep learning structure to estimate the battery capacity with a portion sequence of the charging curve. A sliding voltage window of length 300mV with 10 mV a step is used to extract the corresponding discrete battery capacity, which is both selected as the input of the model. The model is further optimized by the Bayesian Optimization algorithm. The accuracy and robustness of the proposed model are verified on the Oxford battery dataset that it well captures the degradation trend of batteries with its RMSE less than 0.041Ah.

articleTitle: Modeling of Aircraft Maintenance Personnel Requirements Based on Queuing Theory with Experimental Validation
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: Based on the theory of queuing theory and the characteristics of aircraft logistics support maintenance, this paper studies the needs of logistics support personnel in aircraft operation. The demand model of airline maintenance personnel is established. χ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> fit is applied to test the maintenance data, the input flow follows the Poisson distribution, and the aircraft maintenance time follows the negative exponential distribution. In the simulation part, the effects of service order, system load, and the completeness of system maintenance on the performance of the queuing system are studied, it is concluded that the service sequence and system load have a significant impact on the system performance.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis Based on C-DCGAN for Rolling Bearing
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: In actual engineering, the rolling bearing fault samples are small and non-balanced, when the bearing data is unbalanced, the classification of the trained diagnostic model is often inclined to the majority class, which greatly affects the diagnostic accuracy of the minority class. Aiming at the above problems, this paper proposes a fault diagnosis method for generating adversarial network based on conditional deep convolution. Firstly, the bearing vibration signal is converted into a two-dimensional image by using the gram angular field, and then the distribution of the fault data is learned by combining the characteristics of the deep convolutional neural generation adversarial network and the conditional generation adversarial network, and more labeled fault data is generated for the expansion of the fault datasets, and finally the expanded datasets are input into the CNN-SVM diagnostic model. Experimental results show that compared with CGAN, CNN-SVM and other fault diagnosis algorithms, the proposed algorithm can classify bearing faults more accurately.

Author Keywords: Conditional Deep Convolutional Generative Adversarial Network

articleTitle: Unmanned Surface Vehicle Cooperative Task Assignment Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: Task allocation modeling plays an important role in unmanned surface vehicles (USV) collaborative systems. In order to adapt to the complex environment, a cooperative multi-task assignment problem (CMTAP) model suitable for multi-USV, multi-target, and multi-task is designed. The article first clarifies the advantages of collaboration, then based on the traditional genetic algorithm (GA), the crossover and mutation operators are optimized to be more suitable for the current environment. This method utilizes the strong global search ability of GA to optimize the result of cooperative task assignment of USV. Simulation experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Reliability of Two-dimensional Consecutive Voting System
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: k-out-of-n voting systems is widely used in industrial and military fields, and is very common in electronic, mechanical, computer and complex large-scale systems, as a redundancy design to improve the reliability of the system. Two-dimensional voting system is a special form with planar voting logic structure, which is widely used in engineering practice in safety monitoring system, electronic device design, pattern monitoring and other fields. However, there is no analytical equation to calculate the reliability of the system in the existing researches on two-dimensional voting system. Under considering the actual demand in engineering, based on the method of minimum cut sets and the method of minimization algorithm, the failure logic of the two-dimensional voting system is modeled and analyzed. Finally, the reliability calculation equation of two-dimensional voting system in typical state is established, and verified by an example of small-scale system. The results show that the calculated results are in good agreement with the simulation results when the system working time is short.

articleTitle: Simulation Method for Contact Stress of Aerospace Mechanism Bearing Based on Nonlinear Dynamic Model
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: Space mechanism bearing is a key component of spacecraft rotating product transmission mechanism. The performance degradation caused by complex space environment during the in-orbit operation of the bearing is a key factor affecting the reliability spacecraft mechanical products. In this paper, based on the analysis of the nonlinear dynamic model of the space bearing, the finite element method is used to establish the simulation model to realize the research on the contact stress of the space high-speed bearing. The three-dimensional nonlinear contact model of deep groove ball bearing is established by using ANSYS Workbench software. After setting the boundary conditions of the model reasonably, the contact stress and deformation of deep groove ball bearing are simulated and calculated based on the finite element method, and the distribution of contact stress and deformation of different parts of the bearing is obtained. The calculated results are compared with Hertz theoretical solutions, which have good consistency. The results of finite element simulation provide a reference for the design, optimization and failure analysis of rolling bearings, and have certain engineering practical value.

articleTitle: Application Exploration of Digital Twin in Rail Transit Health Management
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: Digital twins have received extensive attention in recent years. Digital twin technology is the continuation and expansion of human ability to understand and transform the world. This paper first analyzes and sorts out the origin of digital twin technology and the application framework of digital twin technology in the field of complex equipment operation and maintenance. The related supporting technologies of digital twin are sorted out. Then a data-driven industrial equipment digital twin construction and maintenance method framework is proposed. Finally, based on the above research, an example software of rail transit health management based on digital twin is developed. This paper makes a preliminary exploration on the application of future digital twin technology in the field of rail vehicle health management.

articleTitle: Distributed Intelligent Health Status Assessment for More Electric Aircraft
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: The distributed arrangement of airborne equipment is an important feature of more electric aircraft. The health status assessment system and method need to be designed for the distributed feature. This paper proposes an intelligent distributed PHM health state assessment method and system for more electric aircraft. The system adopts distributed architecture and optical fiber-wireless hybrid communication to improve the reliability and flexibility of the assessment system. Furthermore, an expert weight determination method based on grey synthetic incidence analysis is proposed to calculate the corresponding weights for different distributed assessment results, which can effectively improve the assessment accuracy.

articleTitle: Bayesian network-based importance analysis of hydraulic winches
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: With the continuous development of the world's oceans, hydraulic winches have been widely used, in order to quickly and accurately determine the weak link of hydraulic winches to improve the reliability of hydraulic winches, this paper proposes a bayesian network-based hydraulic winch importance analysis method. Firstly, the bayesian network of hydraulic winches is established according to the working principle and reliability analysis of hydraulic winches, and then the probability of node occurrence is calculated by using the common life distribution of electromechanical products. In order to verify the accuracy of this method, the results obtained using the proposed method in this paper were compared with those obtained from Griffith importance analysis, and the method was proved to be feasible.

articleTitle: Rolling bearing fault diagnosis based on multiscale texture statistical convolutional neural network
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: Rolling bearing, as a key component of rotating machinery, their health status directly affects the normal operation of mechanical equipment. Therefore, it is necessary to carry out early fault diagnosis of rolling bearings. Convolutional neural network (CNN), with its ability to adaptively extract high-level features from vibration signals, have been widely used. To further enhance the feature extraction capability of CNN, a texture statistics module (TSM) is proposed to introduce the low-level texture features of the signal into CNN. Meanwhile, combining with the multiscale characteristics of the signal, a bearing fault diagnosis algorithm based on multiscale texture statistical convolutional neural network (MSCNN) is proposed. First, the discrete wavelet transform is adopted to obtain multiscale components of the signal, and the texture information is extracted by convolutional layers. TSM performs texture statistics on the texture maps processed by different convolutional layers and uses this as a feature vector for classification. A series of ablation experiments and comparative experiments have verified the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed method.

Author Keywords: multiscale texture statistical convolutional neural network

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Active Omnidirectional Sonobuoy Simulation System
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: Base on the working principle of active omnidirectional sonobuoy, this paper analyzes the ranging and speed measurement based on the modeling of single active omnidirectional sonobuoy and the positioning algorithm of multiple active omnidirectional sonobuoys. The reason for the error in the algorithm and the method to reduce the error are given. A calculation method of the approximate course and speed of the target based on the active omnidirectional sonobuoy array is deduced. Designed and implemented a simulation software system for active omnidirectional sonobuoy detection, and simulation experiments are carried out. The results show that the system can achieve the target information solution, and the error is within the acceptable range.

articleTitle: VampNet-based BTT vibration reconstruction
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: Blade tip-timing (BTT) vibration measurement is seriously under-sampled due to few BTT probes, so it often needs to reconstruct true blade vibration characteristics. In practice, the characteristic of sparsity makes compressed sensing be useful for under-sampled BTT vibration reconstruction. Most existing algorithms still depend on prior sparse information. In recent years, deep learning methods have been investigated to deal with compressed sensing (CS) without prior information. However, traditional deep neural network architectures need many layers for accuracy, leading to more complexity. In order to cope with it, iterative reconstruction algorithms have been recently studied to modify traditional neural-network architectures. Thus, this paper proposes a VampNet-based BTT vibration reconstruction method by using the approximate message passing algorithm. Firstly, the angular-domain CS model of BTT vibration measurement is built. Based on it, the VampNet model of BTT vibration reconstruction is derived. Next, Matlab/Simulink simulations are done to generate BTT samples under variable speeds and then validate the reconstruction accuracy. The simulation results demonstrate that the proposed method can carry out BTT vibration reconstruction faster than existing deep learning methods.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Diagnosis System Based on Aeroengine Knowledge Base
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: This paper studies the fault diagnosis system based on the aeroengine knowledge base, which covers the historical fault data, fault mode data, fault characteristic data of turboshaft/turboprop aero-engine, as well as diagnostic reasoning composed of expert knowledge base and decision rule base. In practical applications, it can assist the crew to troubleshoot the engine. In the current maintenance work, the troubleshooting of the engine is carried out by the maintenance personnel relying on the accumulated experience. With the accumulation of experience, the accuracy of troubleshooting is gradually improved. However, the sharing of personal experiences is poor. With the update of maintenance personnel, the maintenance capability will be reduced and the knowledge wealth will be wasted. The expert system can store and manage these experiences, to quickly realize the aero-engine fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: Vibration suppression of blisk using piezoelectric shunt damping with negative capacitance
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: This paper studies the vibration suppression of the blisk by using the piezoelectric shunt damping based on the negative capacitance. The cyclic symmetry theory is employed to establish the dynamic model of the blisk with negative capacitance. Considering the damping in the electromechanical model, this paper employed the complex mode theory to analyse the dynamic response. The applicability of the proposed model is verified by comparing the eigenfrequencies and frequency response with the commercial software. Finally, the effect of RL and RLNC circuits on vibration suppression are discussed.

articleTitle: Research on rolling bearing fault diagnosis based on improved local linear embedding algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: Manifold learning method has strong ability of complex data processing, is widely applied in the fault diagnosis of rolling bearing, in view of the manifold learning algorithm of the locally linear embedding (LLE) algorithm generalization ability is not strong, poor ability to deal with sparse data were problem, this paper proposes a local linear embedding algorithm based on improved method for rolling bearing fault diagnosis. In this study, the local linear embedding algorithm is improved by using Mahalanobis distance instead of Euclidean distance to construct the local neighborhood, and the distance between samples is homogenized to construct the feature mapping function, which is solved by Lagrange multiplier method. Comparing the dimensionality reduction effect of the traditional algorithm and the improved algorithm, the research results show that the improved algorithm in this study has better dimensionality reduction effect on data and can improve the accuracy of fault identification. Therefore, the proposed method can improve the data processing ability of the local linear embedding algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Entity Update Technology for Fault Diagnosis Knowledge Graph of Cloud Data Center
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: The Fault Diagnosis Knowledge Graph (FDKG) of Cloud Data Center (CDC), in a broad sense, is the knowledge Digital Twin of the fault phenomenon, reasoning, and maintenance process of Cloud Data Center in the physical world. The key to the Digital Twin is to establish the information interface between the physical space and the virtual space, and the key to the construction of the fault diagnosis KG is also here. FDKG of The State Grid Cloud Data Center needs to integrate multi-source knowledge to establish an information interface with the CDCs of subsidiaries in each province.
