As a nonintrusive vibration measurement method, blade tip timing (BTT) technology has the potential to replace strain gauges for blade dynamic stress monitoring, experimental verifications are carried out on a twisted three dimensional blade test bench. The deviation resonance frequency of blade with 3 mm cracked is 0.2% between the finite element calculation and experimental verification. The first order natural frequency of the blade is significantly affected by the crack which is at root. The cracks will lead to the disk mistuning, which causes frequency changes on the healthy blade.

articleTitle: Mixture Test Optimization for Analog System
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: Efficient test strategies are essential for PHM design of analog systems. However, existed strategies fail to match the modern system topology and avoid information redundancy due to various stress, such as sophisticated mechanisms and variable operational conditions. Besides, the time consumption may be raised since independent test operation with sequential strategies. To overcome the above weaknesses, in this paper, we generate a mixture test strategy with our developed approach called heuristic programming (HP). We developed sequential matrix and decision graph to record the relationship between faults and potential tests. Then, the heuristic mechanism of searching is extended to mixture approaches with both sequential testing and parallel testing. Finally, rollout-strategy is introduced to overcome high searching complexity of large-scale systems. The experiments prove that HP and HP-rollout access the strategy with fewer layers and lower cost consumption than those of the state-of-the-art method. Also, both HP and HP-rollout provide more practical strategies than other methods. Additionally, the cost consumption of the strategy based on HP and HP-rollout is improved because of the updating of the test cost and adaptation of mixture OR nodes. Hence, the proposed methods have high efficiency.

articleTitle: Failure Threshold Analysis Based On Multiple Performance Degradation Reliability Assessment Methods
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: The landing gear cabin door locking mechanism is a key component of the aircraft, and its reliability has a direct impact on the aircraft landing gear retraction function and stealth function. Most of the thresholds for the failure characteristics of the locking mechanism are set, and for multiple failure characteristics in the multivariate degradation model, the time when different thresholds take effect may exist before and after in the regression sense, and the failure thresholds based on the correlation of multiple performance characteristics should be synchronized in the regression sense to ensure the time when they take effect. The problem of inter-threshold synchronization has not been noticed by researchers and needs attention. In the article, based on the analysis of the influencing factors of the life of the locking mechanism, the locking angle of the lock hook and the offset of the locking displacement of the lock hook are selected as the performance degradation characteristic quantities; based on the case that the failure thresholds corresponding to the two failure characteristic quantities have been determined, the degradation model is established by Wiener process, so as to obtain the failure probability density function of both; the correlation of the two failure characteristic quantities and the synchronization of their threshold combinations are discussed, and the use of Copula function is used to establish a multi-performance degradation reliability assessment model, and the synchronization of failure thresholds is verified. It is proposed that there is a need to develop a method for determining the threshold combination reflecting the correlation of the characteristic quantities.

articleTitle: Intelligent Location Algorithm of Sensitive Words in English Translation Text Based on Association Rules
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: Because the existence of sensitive words will affect its text transmission, an intelligent location algorithm of sensitive words in English translation text based on association rules is designed. Mining sensitive words in English translation text based on association rule algorithm. In mining, Apriori algorithm is improved, an FT tree association rule algorithm is designed, and sensitive word data mining is implemented. A sensitive word detection model for English translation text is designed and implemented to detect sensitive words in the text. The model consists of four parts: user interface sub model, information preparation sub model, detection engine sub model and audit strategy sub model. The intelligent location of sensitive words in English translation text is realized through Yolo series algorithms. Build a test environment to test the positioning performance of the design method. The test results show that when there is attention mechanism in the model convolution neural network, the location of this method is more accurate and achieves the initial design goal.

articleTitle: Speed Adaptive Gates for Deep-Learning-based Fault Classification of Rotating Machinery under Varying Speed Conditions: Comparison of Implementations
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: Deep-learning-based rotating machinery fault classification often suffers from the problem of speed induced fault information imbalance when applied to varying speed conditions. The speed adaptive gate (SAG) is an effective auxiliary branch that assists existing deep learning models addressing that problem. This paper presents four types of implementations for SAGs, i.e., the element-wise, channel-wise, time-wise and sample-wise, and compares their fault classification performances with a baseline Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) over two experimental datasets including a planetary gearbox dataset and a fixed-shaft gearbox dataset. Results show that the element-wise achieves the highest fault classification accuracy while the time-wise returns the least. But element-wise consumes about 20% more training CPU time than that of the baseline CNN. A good trade-off is the sample-wise with average speed as the input to the SAG, which obtains fair accuracy improvement, but spends only about 5% more training time than the baseline CNN.

articleTitle: Health Factor Prediction Of Power Drive Components Based On GWO-LSTM
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: The power drive device is a crucial component of both weapons and equipment, and its failure due to degradation will have a significant impact on the system’s ability to function normally and have major repercussions. Online real-time prediction is an effective means to monitor the rapid degradation and failure of intact weapons and equipment. First, the power drive device’s failure mechanism is examined. Then, two typical characteristic parameters that can describe the power drive device’s deterioration failure are collected online in real-time. A health factor construction method based on Mahalanobis distance is proposed. Finally, The grey wolf algorithm improves Long Short-Term Memory (GWO-LSTM) network model was used to train and test the health factor. The experimental results show that the BUX10 health factor prediction based on GWO-LSTM has higher prediction accuracy compared with other prediction models.

articleTitle: Research on Mission-oriented Equipment Maintenance Program Evaluation and Optimization Method
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Reliability and Prognostics and Health Management (PHM-Yantai)
abstract: There is a complex coupling between the health status of the equipment, the maintenance program, and the mission performed. Scientific and rational maintenance programs need to be planned according to the specific health status in order to ensure the mission indicator requirements of the equipment. For the mission-oriented equipment maintenance decision optimization problem, a method of mission-oriented equipment maintenance program evaluation and optimization is studied in this paper. Firstly, differentiated maintenance programs are developed based on the health status of the components; then the mission success probability and mission reliability under each maintenance program are evaluated with the help of Monte Carlo numerical simulation algorithms; at the same time, the sensitivity analysis list generated by the simulation process is used to identify the current maintenance problems and to provide guidance for improving the maintenance program; finally, a maintenance assistance decision system is designed and a case study is used to verify the scientific and operational properties of the proposed method.
